# Kondisi Keanekaragaman Hayati di Wilayah Operasional [GRI 304-3]

Pada tahun 2024, dalam operasional TIA, tidak terdapat spesies yang terdampak secara khusus akibat aktivitas penambangan. Area operasional TIA sebelumnya merupakan bagian dari Hutan Tanaman Industri (HTI) dengan dominasi Acacia Mangium, sehingga tidak menimbulkan dampak spesifik terhadap spesies tertentu.

Kegiatan penambangan telah berlangsung sejak tahun 2009 dan direncanakan berlanjut hingga tahun 2025, sementara upaya pemulihan lingkungan telah dilakukan sejak tahun 2010 dan direncanakan berlanjut hingga tahun 2031. Dengan karakteristik lahan yang dapat dipulihkan, dampak aktivitas penambangan dinilai bersifat sementara dan dapat direhabilitasi sesuai dengan peruntukan lahan pascatambang.

Sejalan dengan upaya pemulihan tersebut, reklamasi dan revegetasi dilaksanakan menggunakan komposisi tanaman yang lebih beragam, yaitu sekitar $60\%$ tanaman pionir serta $40\%$ tanaman lokal dan Multi Purpose Tree Species (MPTS), sehingga Perusahaan berupaya meningkatkan tingkat keanekaragaman hayati dibandingkan dengan kondisi rona awal yang homogen. Pengukuran kuantitatif perubahan kondisi biodiversitas secara jangka panjang masih dikembangkan. [GRI 101-7] [SEOJK F.10]

# Biodiversity Conditions in the Operational Area [GRI 304-3]

In 2024, the operations of TIA did not specifically affect any species during their mining activities. The operational area of TIA was previously part of an Industrial Plantation Forest (HTI) predominantly composed of Acacia mangium, so it did not cause notable impacts on any particular species.

Mining activities have been ongoing since 2009 and are scheduled to continue until 2025, while environmental restoration efforts have been carried out since 2010 and are planned to last until 2031. Given the land's recoverable characteristics, the impact of mining activities is considered temporary and can be rehabilitated based on post-mining land use.

In accordance with these restoration efforts, reclamation and revegetation involve using a more diverse plant composition, with approximately $60\%$ pioneer species and $40\%$ native plants and Multi-Purpose Tree Species (MPTS). The company's goal is to increase biodiversity compared to the initial homogeneous condition. Quantitative measurement of long-term biodiversity changes is currently under development. Dalam pemenuhan kewajiban rehabilitasi Daerah Aliran Sungai (DAS), hingga periode 2024–2025 Perseroan telah merealisasikan rehabilitasi seluas 1.745,10 hektare atau setara dengan 100% dari kewajiban yang ditetapkan. Namun demikian, masih terdapat sekitar 290,54 hektare yang dalam tahap pengelolaan dan belum memasuki proses penyerahan kepada otoritas terkait.

Sementara itu, capaian reklamasi pada tahun 2025 belum menunjukkan penambahan luasan dibandingkan periode sebelumnya. Terdapat sekitar 9 hektare yang belum dapat direalisasikan sesuai rencana akibat keterlambatan kegiatan disposal, sehingga pelaksanaan reklamasi mengalami penyesuaian jadwal. Perseroan terus melakukan perencanaan dan koordinasi untuk memastikan kewajiban reklamasi dapat dipenuhi secara bertahap sesuai ketentuan yang berlaku. [GRI 101-2] [SEOJK F.9]

Pelaksanaan reklamasi dan revegetasi dilakukan secara beriringan dengan kegiatan penambangan yang berjalan dan direncanakan dalam Dokumen Rencana Reklamasi yang disetujui regulator sebagai bagian dari upaya pemulihan fungsi ekologis lahan pascatambang. ## Land Reclamation, Rehabilitation, and Revegetation

The reclamation, rehabilitation, and revegetation programs are carried out by ABM and its subsidiaries in a gradual and sustainable manner, engaging local communities, local NGOs, and other third parties to ensure the program's sustainability.

To ensure compliance with regulations, TIA conducts reclamation and restoration activities following the Reclamation Plan approved by the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources, and in reference to the Minister of ESDM Regulation Number 26 of 2018.

The Mining Business License Area (WIUP) of TIA spans 3,085 hectares within a Production Forest zone. The Forest Area Usage Permit (PPKH) covers 1,745.1 hectares, all situated within the designated IUP area. Since commencing operations in 2009, the Company has cleared 1,654.65 hectares for mining activities. To date, TIA has completed reclamation on a total of 901.26 hectares. [GRI 304-1]

In fulfilling its obligations concerning the rehabilitation of the River Basin (DAS), the company has realized rehabilitation of 1,745.10 hectares as of the 2024–2025 period, representing 100% of the set obligation. However, about 290.54 hectares remain in the management phase and have not yet been handed over to the relevant authorities.

Meanwhile, the reclamation achievements in 2025 have not increased the area compared to previous periods. Approximately 9 hectares could not be realized as scheduled due to delays in disposal activities, leading to adjustments to the reclamation schedule. The Company remains committed to planning and coordinating efforts to ensure that reclamation obligations are progressively fulfilled in accordance with applicable regulations. [GRI 101-2] [SEOJK F.9]

Reclamation and revegetation are implemented alongside ongoing and planned mining activities, as detailed in the Reclamation Plan Document approved by the regulator, to restore the ecological functions of post-mining land. [GRI 101-2][GRI 101-5] [GRI 101-6] [GRI 101-8] [SEOJK F.9]

# Pengelolaan Dampak Keanekaragaman Hayati [GRI 101-5] [GRI 101-6] [SEOJK F.9]

ABM menyadari bahwa kegiatan pertambangan berpotensi menimbulkan perubahan tutupan lahan yang dapat berdampak pada keanekaragaman hayati. Oleh karena itu, Perusahaan melakukan identifikasi dan pemetaan lokasi operasional terhadap area sensitif ekologis dengan mengacu pada dokumen AMDAL, rencana tata ruang, serta referensi nasional yang relevan. Berdasarkan hasil kajian, wilayah operasional ABM di Kabupaten Tanah Bumbu, Kalimantan Selatan berada di kawasan Hutan Produksi dan tidak berada di dalam kawasan konservasi yang dilindungi maupun area dengan nilai keanekaragaman hayati tinggi (High Conservation Value).

Selain itu, area operasional tidak berada pada wilayah dengan integritas ekosistem tinggi yang belum terganggu, tidak termasuk dalam kategori wilayah dengan risiko kelangkaan air tinggi sebagaimana diidentifikasi oleh Bappenas dan WRI Aqueduct, serta tidak terletak pada kawasan yang secara khusus ditetapkan sebagai penyedia jasa ekosistem penting bagi Masyarakat Adat atau komunitas lokal. Meskipun demikian, ABM tetap menerapkan prinsip kehati-hatian melalui pelibatan pemangku kepentingan dan pengelolaan dampak lingkungan secara sistematis.

Pengelolaan dampak dilakukan melalui reklamasi progresif, revegetasi dengan spesies yang sesuai kondisi lokal, serta rehabilitasi Daerah Aliran Sungai (DAS) sesuai rencana yang telah disetujui regulator. Pendekatan ini memastikan bahwa setiap perubahan tutupan lahan diikuti dengan upaya pemulihan fungsi ekologis secara terukur dan berkelanjutan.

# Biodiversity Impact Management [GRI 101-5] [GRI 101-6] [SEOJK F.9]

ABM recognizes that mining activities have the potential to cause land cover changes that can impact biodiversity. Consequently, the Company undertakes the identification and mapping of operational sites situated within ecologically sensitive areas based on AMDAL documentation, spatial planning, and relevant national references. According to the study findings, ABM's operational jurisdiction in Tanah Bumbu Regency, South Kalimantan, is located within a Production Forest zone and is not within protected conservation areas or zones characterized by high biodiversity value (High Conservation Value).

Furthermore, the operational area is not situated within regions with high ecosystem integrity and remain undisturbed, nor does it fall into categories of areas at high risk of water scarcity as identified by Bappenas and WRI Aqueduct. It is also not located in areas specifically designated as providers of essential ecosystem services for Indigenous Peoples or local communities. Nevertheless, ABM still applies the principle of prudence through stakeholder engagement and systematic environmental impact management.

Impact management is carried out through progressive reclamation, revegetation with species suitable for local conditions, and rehabilitating Watershed Areas (DAS) according to plans approved by regulators. This approach ensures that any land cover changes are accompanied by measurable and sustainable efforts to restore ecological functions.

# Operasional Lingkungan (Limbah)

Environmental Operations (Waste)

Pengelolaan limbah merupakan bagian integral dari komitmen ABM dalam meminimalkan dampak lingkungan dari kegiatan operasional di sektor pertambangan, energi, dan logistik. Limbah yang dihasilkan dikelola berdasarkan jenis dan karakteristiknya, baik limbah Bahan Berbahaya dan Beracun (B3) maupun limbah non-B3, dengan mengacu pada peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku. ABM telah menetapkan Kebijakan Lingkungan (Environmental Policy ABM-PLC-CAF-005) sebagai kerangka utama pengelolaan lingkungan, sementara ketentuan teknis terkait limbah, air, energi, dan material daur ulang diatur lebih lanjut dalam SOP masing-masing anak usaha agar sesuai dengan karakteristik kegiatan operasional. [GRI 306-1] [SEOJK F.13] [SEOJK F.14] [NDAQ E7]

Seluruh limbah yang dihasilkan dihimpun melalui proses penimbangan, pengukuran, pencatatan, dan dokumentasi yang terstruktur. Data limbah dicatat secara rinci berdasarkan jenisnya, termasuk limbah B3 dan non-B3, dengan satuan pengukuran ton sesuai ketentuan teknis Pemerintah Daerah dan Kementerian Lingkungan Hidup dan Kehutanan (KLHK). Limbah kemudian dikelola melalui mekanisme penyimpanan sementara, pengangkutan, dan pengolahan akhir oleh pihak ketiga berizin untuk memastikan penanganan yang aman, patuh, dan bertanggung jawab. ABM secara berkala mengevaluasi kinerja pengelolaan lingkungan yang mencakup energi, emisi, air, dan limbah. Sepanjang periode pelaporan, ABM tidak memiliki catatan dengan maupun sanksi nonmoneter akibat ketidakpatuhan terhadap peraturan lingkungan hidup. [GRI 2-27] [SEOJK F.28]

Dalam pengelolaan limbah B3, ABM menerapkan pemilahan dan pengendalian yang ketat melalui Tempat Penyimpanan Sementara (TPS B3) yang dipantau secara berkala. Sebagian besar limbah B3 diserahkan kepada transporter dan pengolah resmi yang memiliki izin. Waste management is integral to ABM's commitment to minimizing the environmental impact of operations across the mining, energy, and logistics sectors. The waste generated is managed based on its type and characteristics, including Hazardous and Toxic Materials (B3) waste and non-hazardous (non-B3) waste, following applicable laws and regulations. ABM has established an Environmental Policy (Environmental Policy ABM-PLC-CAF-005) as the main framework for environmental management, while technical provisions related to waste, water, energy, and recycling materials are further regulated in the SOPs of respective subsidiaries to ensure alignment with the specific characteristics of their operational activities. Subsequently, waste is then managed through mechanisms of temporary storage, transportation, and final processing by authorized third parties to ensure safe, compliant, and responsible handling. ABM periodically evaluates environmental management performance, including energy, emissions, water, and waste. # Inisiatif Pengurangan, Pemanfaatan Kembali, dan Daur Ulang Limbah Operasional

ABM menerapkan berbagai inisiatif untuk mengurangi timbulan limbah sekaligus meningkatkan efisiensi operasional melalui prinsip reduce, reuse, dan recycle. Di hampir seluruh site CK, diterapkan filterisasi oli menggunakan sistem kidney loop pada oli hidrolik, transmisi, dan final drive alat berat, sehingga kualitas oli tetap terjaga dan frekuensi penggantian dapat dikurangi. Inisiatif ini berkontribusi langsung pada penurunan volume limbah oli bekas serta penghematan biaya operasional.

Selain itu, solar bekas dari proses penggantian filter bahan bakar dimanfaatkan kembali untuk kebutuhan operasional lain, seperti pengoperasian genset di site, guna mengurangi pemborosan bahan bakar dan timbulan limbah cair. Untuk limbah non-B3, CK BMB dan CK DMP menjalin kerja sama dengan bank sampah, di mana limbah seperti plastik, kertas, dan kardus dikumpulkan dan disalurkan untuk didaur ulang, sehingga mengurangi volume sampah yang dikirim ke tempat pembuangan akhir sekaligus mendukung ekonomi sirkular di masyarakat sekitar.

# Operational Waste Reduction, Reuse, and Recycling Initiative

ABM implements various initiatives to reduce waste generation while simultaneously improving operational efficiency by applying the principles of reduce, reuse, and recycle. At nearly all CK sites, oil filtration is performed using a kidney loop system on hydraulic oil, transmission oil, and final drive of heavy equipment, ensuring oil quality is maintained and replacement frequency is decreased. This initiative directly helps reduce used oil waste volume and operational costs.

Furthermore, used diesel generated from fuel filter replacement processes is reutilized for other operational purposes, such as powering on-site generators, to reduce fuel wastage and liquid waste production. For non-hazardous waste, CK BMB and CK DMP collaborate with waste banks, where waste such as plastics, paper, and cardboard are collected and directed towards recycling, thereby reducing the volume of waste disposed of at final disposal sites and supporting the circular economy within the surrounding community.

ABM

ABM juga mendorong pemanfaatan kembali material operasional, antara lain penggunaan drum oli bekas sebagai wadah air atau bahan bakar cadangan, serta ban bekas yang dimanfaatkan kembali sebagai pembatas jalan, tanggul, dan fungsi pendukung lainnya di area operasional. Pendekatan ini mencerminkan komitmen ABM dalam mengelola limbah secara bertanggung jawab dan memaksimalkan nilai guna material sebelum menjadi residu akhir.

ABM also encourages the reutilization of operational materials, such as repurposing used oil drums as water containers or backup fuel tanks, and converting used tires into road barriers, embankments, and other functional supports within operational areas. This approach reflects ABM's commitment to responsible waste management and the maximum utilization of materials before they are designated as final residues.

# Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja Pertambangan (SMKP) [GRI 403-1] GRI 403-7] [GRI 403-8]

Sebagai bagian dari upaya mitigasi risiko Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (K3) dalam hubungan bisnis, ABM menerapkan pengendalian terintegrasi terhadap seluruh pihak yang berada dalam lingkup operasional, termasuk kontraktor dan mitra kerja. Pendekatan ini memastikan standar K3 ABM dijalankan secara konsisten oleh seluruh tenaga kerja di bawah kendali operasional Perusahaan.

ABM is committed to building an occupational health and safety (K3) culture that ensures a safe, healthy, and comfortable work environment for all workers, by implementing Occupational Health and Safety standards in accordance with national regulations and international practices. K3 management is conducted cross-functionally and facilitated by Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE), while performance evaluation is carried out by the Board of Directors through assessments of routine reports and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) achievements, particularly to ensure the achievement of zero fatalities targets, zero Lost Time Injury (LTI), and zero recordable incidents across all business lines and subsidiaries.

In 2025, ABM continuously conducted periodic evaluations of the implementation of the K3 management system across all operational areas in accordance with SMK3, ISO 45001, and SMKP. This evaluation also includes monitoring and conducting internal and external audits at least once a year, followed by the ISO 45001 certification and recertification process. Audit findings are always followed up by ABM for continuous improvement.

# Hazard Identification, Risk Assessment, and Incident Investigation [GRI 403-2]

To realize a healthy and safe work environment, ABM continuously conducts hazard identification, risk assessment, and incident investigations referring to the regulations and standards above. The hazard and risk identification process, as well as incident investigations, has been structured into the following steps:

- Preparation
- Establishment of an OHS risk management team
- Assignment and determination of work processes for the OHS risk management team
- Collection of relevant information

- HIRADC
- Hazard identification
- Risk assessment
- Determination of risk control measures
- Determination of objectives, targets, and programs

- Implementation and Review
- Management approval
- Communication and consultation
- Implementation of risk control measures
- Routine monitoring and inspections
- Periodic review of HIRADC

- Recording, implementation, and review of HIRADC, OHS performance achievement, hazard identification, incidents, and reporting refer to the applicable regulations in Indonesia for the industry, namely:
- Law No. 1 of 1970 on Occupational Safety

- Other specific regulations, such as regulations from Directorate General of Mineral and Coal Decrees, environmental health regulations, and Office Occupational Safety and Health Standards.

ABM

Dalam proses identifikasi bahaya dan insiden yang tak selalu bisa diprediksi, ABM menerapkan prosedur ketat yang melibatkan partisipasi aktif karyawan, yaitu:

- Kewajiban pelaporan melalui Hazard Report
Karyawan wajib melaporkan setiap bahaya yang ditemukan di area kerja, baik kondisi maupun tindakan yang tidak aman atau berisiko, melalui sistem digital, e-SIAP (salah satu Hazard Report di CK yaitu OSHE. ciptakridatama.co.id). Laporan awal insiden harus dilakukan paling lambat 1x24 jam agar seluruh pihak terkait dapat terinformasi dengan cepat.

- Inspeksi langsung terhadap lokasi dengan insiden
Atasan dari karyawan yang mengalami insiden beserta bagian OSHE dan emergency team (bila diperlukan) harus segera mengunjungi lokasi untuk menangani insiden yang terjadi dan mencatat informasi yang diperlukan untuk investigasi dan pengamanan lokasi dengan insiden.

- Penyelidikan Insiden dan Tindak Lanjut
Berdasarkan klasifikasi keparahan atau kerusakan, ABM akan membentuk tim investigasi atau penyelidikan insiden yang beranggotakan pihak-pihak dengan kompetensi. Penyelidikan dilakukan dalam waktu 2x24 jam setelah kejadian insiden, kecuali untuk insiden besar yang membutuhkan waktu untuk penyelidikan lebih lanjut.

- Rekomendasi Tindakan Perbaikan
Berdasarkan hasil penyelidikan, Tim Investigasi membuat rekomendasi tindakan perbaikan. Laporan investigasi didistribusikan kepada Manajemen dan pihak terkait.

- Pelaksanaan Rekomendasi Perbaikan
Manajemen proyek dan manajemen korporat memastikan setiap rekomendasi dilaksanakan dengan semestinya.

In the process of identifying hazards and incidents that cannot always be predicted, ABM implements strict procedures involving active employee participation, namely:

- Mandatory reporting through Hazard Reports
Employees must report any hazards found in the work area, whether unsafe or risky conditions or actions, through a digital system, e-SIAP (one of the Hazard Report portals at CK, namely OSHE. ciptakridatama.co.id). Initial incident reporting must be made no later than 1x24 hours so that all relevant parties can be informed quickly.

- Direct inspection of the incident location
The supervisor of the employee experiencing the incident, along with OSHE and the Emergency Team (if required), must immediately visit the location to handle the incident and record the information needed for investigation and securing the incident site.

- Incident Investigation and Follow-Up
Based on the severity or damage classification, ABM will form an incident investigation or inquiry team consisting of parties with the relevant competencies. The investigation is conducted within 2x24 hours after the incident occurs, except for major incidents that require time for further investigation.

- Corrective Action Recommendations
Based on the investigation results, the Investigation Team prepares corrective action recommendations. The investigation report is distributed to Management and related parties.

- Implementation of Corrective Recommendations
Project management and corporate management ensure that each recommendation is implemented properly.

Safety briefing dilakukan di setiap shift di seluruh lini operasional Perusahaan.

- Forum Komunikasi K3
Forum komunikasi K3 dibentuk dan dijalankan secara rutin sebagai ruang sosialisasi dan kampanye K3. Forum ini terdiri dari Forum P2K3 yang diadakan setiap bulan. P2K3 merupakan panitia yang beranggotakan perwakilan Manajemen dan perwakilan pekerja, sebagai wadah kerja sama dalam meningkatkan implementasi keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja di lingkungan operasional. Selain itu, pertemuan bulanan dan safety talk juga dilakukan bersama kontraktor dan mitra kerja guna memperkuat budaya keselamatan secara menyeluruh.

- Kampanye K3
Kampanye K3 dilakukan melalui buletin, email, stiker, dan majalah dinding setiap bulan untuk seluruh karyawan. Pemasangan banner dan spanduk K3 dilaksanakan setiap tiga bulan. Program seperti Toolbox Meeting/P5M, peringatan Bulan K3 Nasional, Safety & Health Talk, serta sosialisasi prosedur K3, termasuk penggunaan radio komunikasi dan aplikasi kerja, dilaksanakan secara berkala. Selain itu, setiap karyawan wajib mengikuti induksi K3 setelah kembali dari cuti. Pertemuan bulanan dan safety talk juga dilakukan bersama kontraktor dan mitra kerja.

Sepanjang 2025, P5M dilakukan setiap awal shift, sedangkan HSE Talk diadakan minimal sekali seminggu dengan topik K3 yang bergantian.

Pelatihan ini dirancang sebagai bagian integral dari sistem manajemen K3 untuk memperkuat kompetensi pekerja dalam mengidentifikasi bahaya, menilai risiko, serta menerapkan pengendalian risiko sesuai prinsip Hazard Identification, Risk Assessment, and Determining Control (HIRADC).

## OHS Participation, Consultation, and Communication [GRI 403-3] [GRI 403-4]

To strengthen OHS (K3) discipline and understanding on an ongoing basis, ABM carries out communication and consultation procedures for all employees through:

- Implementation of Safety Briefings
Safety briefings are conducted in every shift across all of the Company's operational lines.

- OHS Communication Forum
An OHS communication forum is established and implemented regularly as a space for OHS socialization and campaigns. This forum consists of the P2K3 Forum, which is held every month. P2K3 is a committee comprising representatives of Management and worker representatives, serving as a forum for cooperation in improving the implementation of occupational safety and health in the operational environment. In addition, monthly meetings and safety talks are also conducted with contractors and business partners to strengthen the overall safety culture.

- OHS Campaigns
OHS campaigns are carried out through monthly bulletins, emails, stickers, and wall magazines for all employees. The installation of OHS banners and signage is carried out every three months. Programs such as Toolbox Meeting/P5M, the commemoration of National OHS Month, Safety & Health Talk, and the socialization of OHS procedures, including the use of communication radios and work applications, are conducted periodically. In addition, each employee is required to undergo OHS induction upon returning from leave. Monthly meetings and safety talks are also conducted with contractors and business partners.

Throughout 2025, P5M was conducted at the start of every shift, while HSE Talk was held at least once a week with rotating OHS topics.

## Pengukuran Efektivitas Pelatihan K3

[GRI 404-1] [OJK F.22]

Pada tahun 2025, ABM melakukan pengukuran efektivitas program pelatihan sebagai bagian dari upaya memastikan bahwa pengembangan kompetensi karyawan memberikan dampak nyata terhadap peningkatan keselamatan kerja. Pengukuran ini difokuskan pada pelatihan Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (K3) yang dilaksanakan di seluruh area operasional, dengan menggunakan pendekatan tiga tingkat evaluasi, yaitu Level 1 evaluasi kembali, Level 2 pasca-uji, dan Level 3 penilaian perilaku. Hasil evaluasi Level 1 menunjukkan persepsi positif peserta terhadap kualitas pelatihan, dengan penilaian terhadap kesesuaian dan kejelasan materi sebesar 34%, kompetensi fasilitator 33%, serta kepuasan terhadap fasilitas 33%.

Sepanjang tahun 2025, ABM telah menyelenggarakan 3.151 pelaksanaan pelatihan K3 dengan total 11.660 jam pembelajaran melalui berbagai metode pembelajaran, termasuk pembelajaran daring, pembelajaran hibrida, pelatihan tatap muka, serta pembelajaran virtual, baik melalui program internal maupun learning implementation yang bekerja sama dengan lembaga eksternal. Program pelatihan ini dirancang untuk memastikan peningkatan kompetensi keselamatan kerja secara berkelanjutan serta mendukung penerapan standar keselamatan di seluruh lini operasional Perusahaan.

Efektivitas pembelajaran juga tercermin pada hasil Level 2, yang menunjukkan peningkatan pemahaman peserta dengan nilai rata-rata pre-test sebesar 63,2 meningkat menjadi 89,9 pada post-test, menghasilkan learning gain sebesar 29,7%. Sementara itu, evaluasi Level 3 menunjukkan bahwa 31,07% pelatihan dinilai sangat efektif, 59,89% efektif, dan 9,04% cukup efektif, tanpa adanya kategori kurang efektif. Materi pelatihan yang diberikan mencakup berbagai topik keselamatan kritis, antara lain ruang terbatas, bekerja di ketinggian, penerapan izin pekerjaan panas, Lock Out Tag Out Try Out (LOTOTO), penanggulangan kebakaran dan tanggap darurat, penguatan komunikasi bahaya, penerapan manajemen kelelahan, serta pelatihan operator alat angkat dan angkut seperti crane, forklift, dan rigging. Selain itu, ABM juga menyelenggarakan pelatihan terkait Implementasi Sistem Manajemen Keselamatan Pertambangan (ISMKP), Pengawas Operasional Pertama (POP) Pertambangan, serta berbagai pelatihan teknis K3 lainnya untuk memastikan seluruh pekerja memiliki kompetensi yang selaras dengan standar keselamatan industri pertambangan.

## OHS Training Effectiveness Measurement

[GRI 404-1] [SEO JK F.22]

In 2025, ABM conducted an effectiveness assessment of its training programs to ensure that employee development initiatives deliver tangible improvements in workplace safety competencies. The assessment focused on Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) training implemented across operational areas, using a three-level evaluation approach consisting of Level 1 (feedback evaluation), Level 2 (post-test), and Level 3 (behavior assessment). Results from the Level 1 evaluation indicated positive participant perceptions of the training quality, with 34% satisfaction related to the relevance and clarity of the materials, 33% for facilitator competence, and 33% for training facilities.

Throughout 2025, ABM delivered 3,151 OHS training sessions with a total of 11,660 learning hours through various learning methods, including e-learning, hybrid learning, in-class training, and virtual learning, implemented through both internal programs and learning implementation in collaboration with external training providers. These training initiatives are designed to continuously enhance safety competencies and support the consistent implementation of safety standards across all operational areas.

The effectiveness of the learning programs is also reflected in the Level 2 evaluation, which showed a significant improvement in participants' knowledge, with the average pre-test score of 63.2 increasing to 89.9 in the post-test, resulting in a 29.7% learning gain. Meanwhile, the Level 3 evaluation indicates that 31.07% of the training programs were rated highly effective, 59.89% effective, and 9.04% moderately effective, with no programs categorized as ineffective. Training topics covered a wide range of critical safety areas, including confined space, working at height, hot work permit, Lock Out Tag Out Try Out (LOTOTO), fire fighting and emergency response, hazard communication, fatigue management, and lifting equipment operation such as crane, forklift, and rigging. In addition, ABM also conducted training on the Implementation of the Mining Safety Management System (ISMKP), First Operational Supervisor (POP) certification, and other technical OHS programs, ensuring that employees maintain competencies aligned with mining industry safety standards.

# Menjaga Kesehatan dan Kesejahteraan Pekerja [GRI 403-3] [GRI 403-6] [GRI 403-10] [OJK F.21]

ABM menyediakan layanan kesehatan kerja sebagai bagian dari sistem perlindungan menyeluruh terhadap pekerja di seluruh wilayah operasional. Fasilitas yang disediakan mencakup klinik dan dokter perusahaan yang mudah diakses, pemeriksaan kesehatan berkala termasuk Medical Check Up (MCU), imunisasi dan vaksinasi, serta konsultasi kesehatan. Layanan ini bertujuan untuk mendeteksi dini risiko kesehatan dan memastikan kondisi kerja yang aman dan sehat bagi pekerja.

Selain layanan kuratif dan preventif, ABM menjalankan program promosi kesehatan yang terintegrasi dengan sistem K3 bagi seluruh karyawan termasuk pekerja bukan karyawan. Program ini meliputi kampanye gaya hidup sehat, edukasi pencegahan penyakit akibat kerja, pengelolaan kelelahan, senam kebugaran, serta sosialisasi melalui berbagai media internal. Perusahaan juga melakukan pemantauan dan pengendalian faktor risiko lingkungan kerja seperti debu, kebisingan, getaran, ergonomi, kualitas air minum, dan sanitasi, guna meminimalkan potensi dampak kesehatan jangka pendek maupun jangka panjang.

Sebagai bagian dari penguatan tata kelola K3, ABM memberikan hak kepada pekerja untuk menolak pekerjaan yang berpotensi membahayakan kesehatan dan keselamatannya hingga risiko tersebut dikendalikan. Disiplin dan akuntabilitas pimpinan, pengawas, serta pekerja terus diperkuat untuk memastikan seluruh prosedur K3 dijalankan secara konsisten.

ABM juga secara sistematis mengidentifikasi dan memetakan potensi Penyakit Akibat Kerja (PAK) berdasarkan paparan faktor kimia, fisika, biologi, maupun penyakit infeksi sesuai dengan Peraturan Presiden No. 7 Tahun 2019 tentang Penyakit Akibat Kerja. Sepanjang tahun 2025, tidak terdapat kasus PAK maupun fatalitas akibat PAK, baik pada karyawan maupun pekerja kontraktor, yang mencerminkan efektivitas pengendalian risiko kesehatan kerja dan penerapan program pencegahan secara berkelanjutan.

# Maintaining Workers' Health and Well-Being [GRI 403-3] [GRI 403-6] [GRI 403-10] [OJK F.21]

ABM provides occupational health services as part of a comprehensive protection system for workers across all operational areas. The facilities provided include easily accessible clinics and company doctors, periodic health examinations including Medical Check Up (MCU), immunization and vaccination, and health consultations. These services aim to detect health risks early and ensure safe and healthy working conditions for workers.

In addition to curative and preventive services, ABM implements health promotion programs integrated with the OHS system for all employees, including non-employee workers. These programs include healthy lifestyle campaigns, education on the prevention of occupational diseases, fatigue management, fitness exercises, and socialization through various internal media. The Company also monitors and controls workplace environmental risk factors such as dust, noise, vibration, ergonomics, drinking water quality, and sanitation, to minimize potential short-term and long-term health impacts.

As part of strengthening OHS governance, ABM grants workers the right to refuse work that may endanger their health and safety until the risks are controlled. Leadership discipline and accountability of leaders, supervisors, and workers continue to be strengthened to ensure that all OHS procedures are implemented consistently.

ABM also systematically identifies and maps potential Occupational Diseases (PAK) based on exposure to chemical, physical, biological factors, as well as infectious diseases in accordance with Presidential Regulation (Peraturan Presiden) No. 7 of 2019 on Occupational Diseases. Throughout 2025, there were no cases of occupational diseases (PAK) or fatalities due to PAK, either among employees or contractor workers, reflecting the effectiveness of occupational health risk controls and the continuous implementation of prevention programs.

# Komitmen ABM terhadap Keselamatan Kerja

Keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja merupakan prioritas utama ABM dalam setiap aktivitas operasional. Pada tahun pelaporan, terjadi satu insiden Lost Time Injury (LTI) di salah satu lokasi operasional SSB, di mana seorang pekerja mengalami cedera pada bagian kepala akibat terpentalnya jig dan jack hydraulic saat proses pembongkaran komponen spring coil. Peristiwa ini menjadi pengingat bahwa setiap aktivitas kerja mengandung risiko yang harus dikelola secara disiplin dan konsisten.

ABM memandang insiden tersebut sebagai pembelajaran bersama untuk memperkuat budaya keselamatan di seluruh lini operasi. Sebagai tindak lanjut, Perusahaan melaksanakan safety stand down meeting, melakukan rekayasa ulang pada jig pembongkaran spring coil dengan penambahan safety guard dan pengikatan jig ke lantai kerja, serta memasang safety sign peringatan bahaya di area terkait. Selain itu, dilakukan identifikasi kesesuaian jig dengan jenis pekerjaan serta proses inquiry job review.

ABM juga memberikan coaching kepada operator dan pengawas guna memastikan pemahaman risiko dan kepatuhan terhadap prosedur kerja aman. Melalui langkah-langkah tersebut, ABM menegaskan komitmennya untuk mencegah kejadian serupa dan terus menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang aman, sehat, dan saling peduli bagi seluruh insan perusahaan.

# ABM's Commitment to Occupational Safety

Occupational safety and health is ABM's top priority in every operational activity. In the reporting year, one Lost Time Injury (LTI) incident occurred at one of SSB's operational sites, where a worker sustained a head injury after a jig and hydraulic jack were ejected during the dismantling process of a spring coil component. This incident serves as a reminder that every work activity carries risks that must be managed with discipline and consistency.

ABM views the incident as a shared learning opportunity to strengthen the safety culture across all operational lines. As a follow-up, the Company conducted a safety stand down meeting, re-engineered the spring coil dismantling jig by adding a safety guard and anchoring the jig to the workshop floor, and installed safety warning signs in the relevant area. In addition, identification was carried out regarding the suitability of the jig for the type of work, as well as an inquiry job review process.

ABM also provided coaching to operators and supervisors to ensure their understanding of risks and compliance with safe work procedures. Through these measures, ABM reaffirms its commitment to preventing similar incidents and to continuously creating a safe, healthy, and caring work environment for all members of the Company.

## Employee Diversity and Turnover

[GRI 2-7][GRI 2-8] [GRI 401-1] [NDAQ S3] [NDAQ S4]

To ensure the Company remains superior and competitive, ABM continuously monitors employee turnover and ensures a good retention rate. Turnover management is carried out by the Human Resource unit at the head office and subsidiaries. The turnover target is set at below 5 percent each year.

Various policies are implemented to achieve this target, including:

- Strategic Manpower Planning aligned with the Company's short-, medium-, and long-term strategic direction.
- Benchmarking by referring to turnover best practices implemented in comparable companies and related industry sectors.
- Employee retention programs and the implementation of an Employee Engagement Survey (EES) to retain top talent.
- Employee development programs through integrated learning and career development.

In 2025, the ABM Group conducted an EES and obtained a score of 85% which indicates a positive employee retention rate.

ABM juga menetapkan jenis pekerjaan tertentu yang dapat dilakukan oleh tenaga nonkaryawan, yaitu pekerjaan yang tidak berhubungan langsung dengan proses produksi maupun proses bisnis inti perusahaan, seperti layanan kebersihan dan administrasi pendukung. Perusahaan tidak menerapkan skema pekerja paruh waktu, namun menyediakan program magang sebagai sarana pengembangan talenta muda dan pemenuhan kebutuhan operasional jangka menengah.

Dalam pengelolaan karyawan kontrak (PKWT), ABM mematuhi seluruh ketentuan ketenagakerjaan yang berlaku, dengan masa kerja maksimal hingga lima tahun yang dapat terdiri dari beberapa periode kontrak. Setiap perpanjangan kontrak dilakukan secara adil dan transparan berdasarkan evaluasi kinerja serta kebutuhan operasional, guna memastikan kepatuhan hukum sekaligus perlindungan hak-hak karyawan.

Selama tahun pelaporan, Perusahaan melakukan penyesuaian terhadap jumlah dan komposisi karyawan sejalan dengan dinamika operasional. Di situs CK, terjadi perubahan pada kelompok usia produktif yang lebih muda, terutama sebagai dampak penghentian pekerjaan kontrak di Provinsi Kalimantan Selatan dan Kalimantan Timur, serta pelaksanaan Pemutusan Hubungan Kerja (PHK) terhadap karyawan PKWTT di Provinsi Kalimantan Selatan dan Jambi. Kondisi tersebut turut memengaruhi tingkat turnover karyawan serta penurunan jumlah karyawan pada tahun 2025.

Selain itu, peningkatan proporsi karyawan PKWT dipengaruhi oleh penutupan salah satu area pertambangan dan berakhirnya kegiatan operasional di lokasi tersebut. Penyesuaian struktur tenaga kerja dilakukan secara bertahap melalui skema kontrak yang diselaraskan dengan kebutuhan transisi operasional, dengan tetap menjunjung tinggi prinsip kepatuhan terhadap peraturan ketenagakerjaan serta perlindungan hak-hak karyawan.

ABM also determines certain types of work that may be performed by non-employee workers, namely work that is not directly related to the production process or the company's core business processes, such as cleaning services and supporting administration. The Company does not implement a part-time worker scheme, but provides an internship program as a means of developing young talent and meeting medium-term operational needs.

In managing contract employees (PKWT), ABM complies with all applicable labor provisions, with a maximum employment period of up to five years, which may consist of several contract periods. Each contract extension is carried out fairly and transparently based on performance evaluations and operational needs, to ensure legal compliance as well as the protection of employees' rights.

During the reporting year, the Company made adjustments to the number and composition of employees in line with operational dynamics. At CK sites, changes occurred in the younger productive age group, primarily as an impact of the termination of contract work in the Provinces of South Kalimantan and East Kalimantan, as well as the implementation of termination of employment (PHK) for PKWTT employees in the Provinces of South Kalimantan and Jambi. These conditions also affected the employee turnover rate as well as a decrease in the number of employees in 2025.

In addition, the increase in the proportion of PKWT employees was influenced by the closure of one mining area and the end of operational activities at that location. Adjustments to the workforce structure were carried out gradually through contract schemes aligned with the needs of the operational transition, while continuing to uphold the principles of compliance with labor regulations and protection of employees' rights.

## Pengembangan Kompetensi dan Evaluasi Kinerja [GRI 404-1][GRI 404-3]

ABM menyelenggarakan berbagai program pelatihan dan pengembangan kompetensi untuk mendukung peningkatan kapabilitas karyawan di seluruh jenjang jabatan dan fungsi kerja.

Pelatihan dan pengembangan karyawan dilaksanakan secara berkelanjutan sepanjang tahun, disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan kompetensi, tuntutan operasional, serta pengembangan karier jangka panjang.

ABM juga secara berkala melakukan evaluasi kinerja dan pengembangan karier melalui sistem penilaian kinerja yang terstruktur, yang menjadi dasar dalam penetapan program pengembangan kompetensi, promosi, maupun perencanaan suksesi.

## Competency Development and Performance Evaluation [GRI 404-1][GRI 404-3]

ABM organizes various training programs and competency development initiatives to support the enhancement of employee capabilities across all job levels and work functions.

Employee training and development are carried out continuously throughout the year, tailored to competency needs, operational demands, and long-term career development.

ABM also periodically conducts performance evaluation and career development through a structured performance appraisal system, which serves as the basis for determining competency development programs, promotions, and succession planning.

Dalam mendukung efektivitas pelatihan dan pengembangan tersebut, ABM menerapkan pendekatan manajemen pengembangan sumber daya manusia yang berorientasi pada kesiapan karyawan dalam menghadapi tantangan dan peluang di industri pertambangan. Program pengembangan kompetensi dirancang untuk memastikan peningkatan kualitas kinerja karyawan sejalan dengan kebutuhan bisnis masa depan dan keberlanjutan Perusahaan.

Sebagai kerangka pengembangan SDM, ABM telah menetapkan Strategi People Development yang menitikberatkan pada penguatan empat aspek utama (4C), yaitu Capability, Competence, Character, dan Contribution. Strategi ini dilandasi filosofi bahwa seluruh karyawan memiliki kesempatan yang setara untuk dikembangkan sesuai potensi dan kebutuhannya, membangun kompetensi saat ini dan masa depan, serta menumbuhkan karakter kepemimpinan yang selaras dengan nilai Perusahaan. # Rata-Rata Jam Pelatihan per Tahun per Karyawan [GRI 404-1][OJK F.22]

ABM secara rutin melaksanakan pelatihan dan pengembangan kepada karyawan guna meningkatkan kompetensi. Sepanjang tahun 2025, ABM telah menyelenggarakan 110.118 jam pelatihan dengan rata-rata jam pelatihan 6,18 per karyawan per tahun dan total jumlah peserta mencapai 26.832 karyawan. Realisasi biaya pelatihan tahun 2025 mencapai Rp 9,51 Miliar.

Pelaksanaan pelatihan tersebut difasilitasi melalui ABM Academy yang berfungsi sebagai pusat pengembangan karyawan. ABM Academy menyediakan berbagai program pembelajaran untuk memperkuat keterampilan teknis, kepemimpinan, dan kompetensi pendukung lainnya yang relevan dengan kebutuhan bisnis dan operasional Perusahaan.

Pada tahun 2025, jumlah partisipan pelatihan meningkat dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya, meskipun total durasi pelatihan menurun. Perubahan ini sejalan dengan optimalisasi metode pembelajaran melalui pendekatan digital dan blended learning, yang memungkinkan penyampaian materi secara lebih ringkas, modular, dan berbasis kebutuhan spesifik unit kerja. Jika sebelumnya pelatihan didominasi format tatap muka berdurasi panjang, pada tahun 2025 pelaksanaan difokuskan pada sesi tematik yang lebih terarah dan efisien tanpa mengurangi kualitas pembelajaran.

To support the effectiveness of such training and development, ABM implements a human resource development management approach oriented toward employee readiness in facing challenges and opportunities in the mining industry. Competency development programs are designed to ensure improvements in employee performance quality in line with future business needs and the Company's sustainability.

As a human resource development framework, ABM has established a People Development Strategy that emphasizes strengthening four main aspects (4C), namely Capability, Competence, Character, and Contribution. This strategy is grounded in the philosophy that all employees have equal opportunities to be developed according to their potential and needs, to build current and future competencies, and to foster leadership character aligned with the Company's values. [SEOJK F.22][GRI 404-2]

# Average Training Hours per Employee per Year [GRI 404-1][OJK F.22]

ABM regularly conducts training and development for employees to improve competencies. Throughout 2025, ABM organized 110,118 training hours, with an average of 6.18 training hours per employee per year, and a total number of participants reaching 26,832 employees. The realization of training costs in 2025 amounted to Rp9.51 billion.

The implementation of such training was facilitated through ABM Academy, which functions as an employee development center. ABM Academy provides various learning programs to strengthen technical skills, leadership, and other supporting competencies relevant to the Company's business and operational needs.

In 2025, the number of training participants increased compared to the previous year, although the total training duration declined. This change aligns with the optimization of learning methods through digital and blended learning approaches, which enable the delivery of materials in a more concise, modular, and specific unit-based manner. Whereas previously training was dominated by long-duration face-to-face formats, in 2025 implementation was focused on more targeted and efficient thematic sessions without reducing learning quality.

Sebagai bagian dari transformasi digital pengembangan kompetensi, ABM memulai transisi ke sistem e-learning pada Juni 2025 melalui tahap pengenalan dan implementasi awal di Section A, sementara lehel lainnya masih menggunakan pendekatan blended learning. Tahap lanjutan direncanakan pada November 2025 sebagai bagian dari roadmap bertahap. Transformasi ini mendukung efektivitas anggaran sekaligus mendorong kemandirian pembelajaran karyawan, dengan proses adaptasi yang masih berlangsung untuk memastikan implementasi berjalan optimal di seluruh entitas.

Sebagai bagian dari transformasi digital pengelolaan SDM, ABM juga mengimplementasikan sistem SAP Success Factors yang dikenal dengan nama FALCON. Sistem ini mendukung proses rekrutmen dan onboarding, manajemen kinerja dan kompensasi, pengembangan talenta, serta perencanaan suksesi secara terintegrasi dan transparan, sehingga menjadi investasi berkelanjutan dalam pengembangan sumber daya manusia ABM.

As part of the digital transformation of competency development, ABM began transitioning to an e-learning system in June 2025 through an awareness stage and initial implementation in Section A, while other levels still used a blended learning approach. The next stage was planned for November 2025 as part of a phased roadmap. This transformation supports budget effectiveness while encouraging employee learning independence, with the adaptation process still ongoing to ensure implementation runs optimally across all entities.

As part of the digital transformation of human resource management, ABM also implemented the SAP SuccessFactors system known as FALCON. This system supports recruitment and onboarding processes, performance and compensation management, talent development, and succession planning in an integrated and transparent manner, thereby serving as a sustainable investment in ABM's human resource development.

# Pendekatan Continuous Improvement untuk Perbaikan Proses Bisnis Berkelanjutan

Dalam implementasi Continuous Improvement (CI), ABM mengadopsi dua pendekatan utama yang saling melengkapi, yaitu Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA) dan Define-Measure-Analyze-Improve-Control (DMAIC), sebagai kerangka kerja untuk mendorong perbaikan proses yang sistematis, terukur, dan berkelanjutan.

PDCA digunakan sebagai siklus perbaikan berkelanjutan untuk memastikan proses berjalan secara konsisten dan adaptif. Tahap Plan berfokus pada identifikasi masalah dan perencanaan perbaikan; Do pada pelaksanaan solusi yang telah dirancang; Check pada evaluasi hasil dan kinerja proses; serta Act pada standarisasi perbaikan atau penyesuaian lanjutan. Pendekatan ini mendorong budaya belajar berkelanjutan dan perbaikan bertahap di seluruh lini operasional.

DMAIC merupakan metodologi utama dalam Six Sigma yang digunakan untuk menyelesaikan permasalahan proses secara lebih mendalam dan berbasis data. Define menetapkan ruang lingkup dan tujuan perbaikan; Measure mengukur kinerja proses dan variabilitasnya; Analyze mengidentifikasi akar penyebab masalah; Improve merancang dan menerapkan solusi; dan Control memastikan perbaikan dapat dipertahankan dalam jangka panjang. DMAIC sangat efektif untuk mengurangi defect, meningkatkan kapabilitas proses, dan menjaga kualitas secara konsisten.

Untuk mendukung penerapan CI secara berjenjang, ABM mengembangkan sistem tingkatan Belt sebagai jalur pembelajaran dan pengembangan kompetensi karyawan, yaitu:

- White Belt (CI Awareness): Pengenalan konsep dasar CI, Lean, dan Six Sigma, serta peran individu dalam mengidentifikasi peluang perbaikan di area kerja.
- Yellow Belt: Fokus pada partisipasi aktif dalam proyek perbaikan sederhana dan penerapan dasar Lean untuk mengurangi pemborosan.
- Green Belt: Penerapan metodologi CI dan Six Sigma secara lebih mendalam melalui proyek perbaikan lintas fungsi yang berdampak pada kinerja operasional.
- Black Belt: Pengembangan key talent yang memimpin proyek perbaikan strategis, berperan sebagai change agent, trainer, dan coach dalam organisasi.
- Master Black Belt: Peran di dalam pengembangan metodologi, pembinaan Black Belt, serta penguatan budaya CI di tingkat organisasi.

Melalui penerapan PDCA, DMAIC, dan sistem Belt yang terstruktur, ABM memastikan bahwa perbaikan berkelanjutan tidak hanya menjadi inisiatif sesaat, tetapi tertanam sebagai budaya kerja yang mendukung keselamatan, kualitas, efisiensi, dan keberlanjutan bisnis jangka panjang.

# Continuous Improvement Approach for Sustainable Business Process Improvement

In implementing Continuous Improvement (CI), ABM adopts two main complementary approaches, namely Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA) and Define-Measure-Analyze-Improve-Control (DMAIC), as a framework to drive systematic, measurable, and sustainable process improvements.

PDCA is used as a continuous improvement cycle to ensure that processes run consistently and adaptively. The Plan stage focuses on problem identification and improvement planning; Do on implementing the designed solutions; Check on evaluating outcomes and process performance; and Act on standardizing improvements or making further adjustments. This approach promotes a culture of continuous learning and incremental improvements across all operational lines.

DMAIC is the primary methodology in Six Sigma used to resolve process issues in a more in-depth and data-driven manner. Define establishes the scope and objectives of improvement; Measure assesses process performance and variability; Analyze identifies root causes of problems; Improve designs and implements solutions; and Control ensures improvements can be sustained over the long term. DMAIC is highly effective in reducing defects, improving process capability, and consistently maintaining quality.

To support the tiered implementation of CI, ABM developed a Belt level system as a learning pathway and employee competency development, as follows:

- White Belt (CI Awareness): Introduction to the basic concepts of CI, Lean, and Six Sigma, as well as the role of individuals in identifying improvement opportunities in the work area.
- Yellow Belt: Focus on active participation in simple improvement projects and the basic application of Lean to reduce waste.
- Green Belt: More in-depth application of CI and Six Sigma methodologies through cross-functional improvement projects that impact operational performance.
- Black Belt: Development of key talent leading strategic improvement projects, serving as change agents, trainers, and coaches within the organization.
- Master Black Belt: A role in methodology development, coaching Black Belts, and strengthening the CI culture at the organizational level.

Through the implementation of PDCA, DMAIC, and a structured Belt system, ABM ensures that continuous improvement is not merely a temporary initiative, but is embedded as a work culture that supports safety, quality, efficiency, and long-term business sustainability.

# Suara Perempuan di Dunia Tambang yang Maskulin

Di industri pertambangan yang selama ini identik dengan dominasi laki-laki, keberanian untuk melangkah sering kali menjadi titik awal perubahan. Apriaty Sirait adalah salah satu bukti bahwa batasan dapat ditembus melalui ketekunan, pembelajaran, dan kesempatan yang setara.

Memulai karier sebagai Fresh Green Operator (FGO) pada 2009, Apriaty mengoperasikan alat berat berkapasitas ratusan ton di tengah medan tambang yang menuntut ketelitian dan disiplin tinggi. Perjalanan tersebut tidak selalu mulus, ia pernah mengalami masa jeda karier dan tantangan personal, namun setiap fase justru memperkuat tekadnya untuk terus berkembang. Komitmen terhadap pembelajaran mendorong Apriaty menempuh sertifikasi dan meningkatkan kompetensi hingga akhirnya bergabung dengan CK pada 2021.

Di CK, Apriaty memperoleh kesempatan upskilling melalui sertifikasi Training of Trainer (TOT) dan mencatatkan sejarah sebagai trainer perempuan pertama di Mining Academy. Hingga kini, ia telah membimbing lebih dari 300 trainee dari berbagai site sebagian besar laki-laki sekaligus menjadi simbol bahwa perempuan memiliki ruang untuk memimpin dan menginspirasi di sektor tambang.

Dedikasi tersebut mendapat pengakuan nasional melalui Penghargaan Perempuan BERBAKTI 2025 kategori Perempuan Berbakti di Perusahaan yang kini diberikan secara reguler oleh ABM untuk meningkatkan kepemimpinan dan suara perempuan di dunia tambang. Bagi Apriaty, penghargaan ini bukan sekadar pencapaian pribadi, melainkan representasi dari perjuangan banyak perempuan yang terus membuktikan kapasitasnya di sektor strategis.

Lebih dari sekadar cerita individu, perjalanan Apriaty menegaskan bahwa transformasi industri dimulai dari keberanian memberi kesempatan. Di CK, pembangunan manusia termasuk pemberdayaan perempuan menjadi fondasi penting dalam membentuk masa depan industri pertambangan yang tangguh dan berkelanjutan.

# Women's Voices in the Masculine World of Mining

In the mining industry, which has long been synonymous with male dominance, the courage to take a step forward is often the starting point of change. Apriaty Sirait is one proof that boundaries can be broken through perseverance, learning, and equal opportunity.

Starting her career as a fresh graduate operator in 2009, Apriaty operated heavy equipment with a capacity of hundreds of tons amid mining terrain that demands high precision and discipline. The journey was not always smooth—she experienced a career hiatus and personal challenges—yet each phase in fact strengthened her determination to keep growing. Her commitment to learning encouraged Apriaty to pursue certifications and enhance her competencies, until she eventually joined CK in 2021.

At CK, Apriaty gained upskilling opportunities through Training of Trainer (TOT) certification and made history as the first female trainer at the Mining Academy. To date, she has mentored more than 300 trainees from various sites, most of whom are male, while also becoming a symbol that women have space to lead and inspire in the mining sector.

Her dedication received national recognition through the 2025 Perempuan BERBAKTI Award in the Perempuan Berbakti di Perusahaan category, which is now granted regularly by ABM to enhance women's leadership and voice in the mining world. For Apriaty, this award is not merely a personal achievement, but a representation of the struggle of many women who continue to prove their capabilities in a strategic sector.

More than an individual story, Apriaty's journey underscores that industry transformation begins with the courage to provide opportunities. At CK, human development—including empowering women—serves as an important foundation in shaping a resilient and sustainable future for the mining industry.

# Prevention of Child Labor [SEOJK F.19] [GRI 408-1][NDAQ S9]

The Company is fully committed to preventing the presence of child labor across all operational areas. This commitment is implemented by complying with all applicable labor regulations, including the Manpower Law as well as ILO Convention No. 138 on the minimum age for employment and ILO Convention No. 182 on the elimination of the worst forms of child labor.

As a form of compliance with both national and international standards, ABM and all subsidiaries set the minimum employee age at 18 years, as stated in the Company Regulation.

ABM understands that the characteristics of the Company's operational activities carry a high level of risk and require special skills and expertise, and therefore are not appropriate for involving minors in work activities. Accordingly, the Company consistently implements a child labor prevention policy as part of its commitment to protecting children's rights and respecting human rights.

Based on this policy, all ABM operations and suppliers are declared not to have significant risk related to child labor incidents, as all business activities are carried out with reference to the human rights policies applicable within the Company and the ABM Group.

[SEOJK F.23]

Based on the SROI conducted by the Center for Entrepreneurship, Change, and Third Sector (CECT) Trisakti, farmers experienced increased knowledge, easier market access through BUMDes, and increased income. # Bunda Peduli Asupan Sehat (Bunda PAS) Program

Launched through CKB, ABM collaborates with local health workers and village governments in Surabaya, East Java. This program provides direct nutritional support, education, and community empowerment to address stunting.

The program operates in four urban villages in Benowo District—Tambak Osowilangun, Sememi/Semeni, Kandangan, and Romokalisari—and reaches 50 children at risk of stunting through regular nutrition packages (eggs, milk, vitamins), growth monitoring, training for caregivers, and coordination with Puskesmas. In addition, the program is also implemented in North Jakarta, specifically in Sukapura Urban Village, Cilincing District. ABM's total contribution in 2025 for this program was IDR 65.49 million.

With the program intervention focused on the first 1,000 days of life, ABM ensures that this program targets the root causes of stunting, namely chronic malnutrition, lack of caregiving knowledge, and limited access to nutritious food, rather than merely providing assistance that does not address the underlying issues (ad-hoc aid).

# Impacts of the Bunda PAS Program

Based on the SROI conducted by the Center for Entrepreneurship, Change, and Third Sector (CECT) Trisakti, the Bunda PAS program in Jakarta generated social impacts including, among others, toddlers' nutritional intake being adequately fulfilled and routinely monitored, improved fine and gross motor development for toddlers, cost efficiency in meeting children's nutritional needs, and a reduction in stunting rates in Sukapura District.

The Social Return on Investment analysis conducted by ABM and CECT Sustainability Universitas Trisakti for the program in North Jakarta shows that every Rp1 invested in this program generated Rp 1.43 in social impact value.

# Restorasi Ekosistem Pesisir melalui Rehabilitasi Mangrove

Pada tahun 2025, ABM memperkuat komitmen restorasi pesisir melalui program rehabilitasi mangrove yang dilaksanakan bersama CK, CKB, PWP, dan SSB. Dengan mengandalkan keahlian teknis dan logistik anak perusahaan, program ini mencakup edukasi, penanaman, dan pemantauan pascatanam untuk memastikan kelangsungan hidup bibit.

Upaya ini diarahkan untuk melindungi pesisir pantai, meningkatkan keanekaragaman hayati, dan menciptakan nilai bersama melalui keterlibatan karyawan dan masyarakat. Pada tahun 2025, program rehabilitasi mangrove dilaksanakan di Mangrove Romokalisari, Surabaya, dengan penanaman 6.000 bibit sebagai bagian dari target total 10.000 mangrove. Selain itu, pada bulan Desember 2025, ABM juga melaksanakan penanaman 10.000 bibit mangrove di kawasan Urban Aquaculture, Desa Mauk, Tangerang.

Secara jangka panjang, program ini diharapkan memberikan manfaat ekologis berkelanjutan, dengan kemampuan mangrove untuk menyerap karbon dan menjaga ekosistem pesisir hingga lebih dari 20 tahun.

# Coastal Ecosystem Restoration through Mangrove Rehabilitation

In 2025, ABM strengthened its coastal restoration commitment through a mangrove rehabilitation program implemented together with CK, CKB, PWP, and SSB. In commemoration of International Biodiversity Day and under the theme "Empower the Shoreline, Protect the Future", ABM and its subsidiaries mobilized employees, local communities, and coastal stakeholders to plant mangroves in abrasion-prone areas. Leveraging the technical and logistical expertise of its subsidiaries, the program includes education, planting, and postplanting monitoring to ensure seedling survival.

These efforts are directed at protecting coastlines, enhancing biodiversity, and creating shared value through employee and community engagement. In 2025, the mangrove rehabilitation program was carried out at Mangrove Romokalisari, Surabaya, with the planting of 6,000 seedlings as part of a total target of 10,000 mangroves. In addition, in December 2025, ABM also planted 10,000 mangrove seedlings in the Urban Aquaculture area, Mauk Village, Tangerang.

In the long term, this program is expected to provide sustainable ecological benefits, with mangroves' ability to absorb carbon and preserve coastal ecosystems for more than 20 years.

# Respons Cepat ABM untuk Banjir & Longsor Sumatera 2025

ABM's Rapid Response to the 2025 Sumatra Floods and Landslides [GRI 203-2]

![img-88.jpeg](img-88.jpeg)

Menanggapi bencana banjir dan longsor yang melanda Aceh, Sumatera Utara, dan Sumatera Barat pada 2025, Grup ABM bersama entitas dalam Grup TMT melalui kolaborasi dengan Human Initiative mengaktifkan program tanggap darurat untuk memastikan pemenuhan kebutuhan dasar masyarakat terdampak, khususnya kelompok masyarakat yang terdampak secara signifikan oleh bencana. Sebagai bagian dari komitmen kemanusiaan tersebut, Grup TMT menyalurkan bantuan senilai Rp 2,5 milyar kepada masyarakat terdampak di Aceh, khususnya di wilayah Aceh Tamiang dan Aceh Utara yang mengalami dampak paling parah akibat bencana banjir bandang, luapan sungai, dan tanah longsor yang terjadi pada akhir November 2025.

Sebanyak 55 relawan diterjunkan ke wilayah terdampak untuk melaksanakan evakuasi, distribusi bantuan, dan pendirian pos tanggap darurat. Selain dukungan relawan, bantuan yang disalurkan juga mencakup berbagai kebutuhan dasar masyarakat, antara lain paket sembako, perlengkapan hunian darurat (terpal, tikar, paku), peralatan memasak, perlengkapan mandi, paket kebutuhan dasar, perlengkapan tempat tidur (kasur, selimut, bantal, kelambu), pengadaan air bersih melalui water trucking, serta alat kebersihan rumah dan community working tools untuk mendukung proses pembersihan lingkungan pascabencana.

Selain bantuan logistik, dukungan operasional juga diberikan melalui pengerahan alat berat untuk membantu pembukaan akses jalan di wilayah terdampak sehingga proses evakuasi dan distribusi bantuan dapat berjalan lebih efektif. Emergency Response Team (ERT) juga diterjunkan untuk mendukung evakuasi korban, distribusi bantuan kebutuhan dasar, serta pendirian dapur umum bagi masyarakat terdampak.

Inisiatif ini mencerminkan komitmen ABM dalam mendukung pengurangan risiko dan kerugian akibat krisis kemanusiaan, sekaligus memastikan masyarakat terdampak memperoleh bantuan secara cepat, tepat sasaran, dan bermartabat. Selain di Aceh, dukungan kemanusiaan juga disalurkan ke wilayah terdampak lainnya di Sumatera Utara dan Sumatera Barat, termasuk Kabupaten Tapanuli Tengah, Tapanuli Selatan, dan Kabupaten Agam, sebagai bagian dari upaya kolaboratif untuk mempercepat pemulihan masyarakat pascabencana.

In response to the floods and landslides that struck Aceh, North Sumatra, and West Sumatra in 2025, ABM Group together with entities within the TMT Group, in collaboration with Human Initiative, activated an emergency response program to ensure the fulfillment of the basic needs of affected communities, particularly those significantly impacted by the disaster. As part of this humanitarian commitment, TMT Group provided assistance amounting to Rp2.5 billion to affected communities in Aceh, particularly in Aceh Tamiang and North Aceh, which were among the areas most severely impacted by flash floods, river overflows, and landslides that occurred in late November 2025.

A total of 55 volunteers were deployed to the affected areas to conduct evacuations, distribute assistance, and establish emergency response posts. Along with volunteer support, the aid offered also covered various basic needs for affected communities, such as food parcels, shelter kits (tarpaulins, mats, nails), cooking utensils, hygiene kits, dignity kits, bedding kits (mattresses, blankets, pillows, mosquito nets), supply of clean water through water trucking, as well as household cleaning supplies and community tools to assist with post-disaster clean-up efforts.

In addition to logistical aid, operational support has been supplied by deploying heavy equipment to clear roads in the affected areas, thereby facilitating more efficient evacuation and distribution of assistance. An Emergency Response Team (ERT) has also been deployed to assist with evacuations, distribute basic necessities, and establish community kitchens for those affected communities.

This initiative reflects ABM's commitment to supporting the reduction of risks and losses from humanitarian crises, while ensuring that affected communities receive assistance quickly, accurately targeted, and with dignity. Beyond Aceh, humanitarian assistance was also extended to other affected areas in North Sumatra and West Sumatra, including Central Tapanuli, South Tapanuli, and Agam Regency, as part of a collaborative effort to accelerate community recovery after the disaster.

# Pendekatan Manajemen untuk Governansi

ABM membangun pendekatan governansi yang berorientasi pada keberlanjutan dengan menyeimbangkan kinerja ekonomi, lingkungan, dan sosial. Pendekatan governansi ABM dibangun atas dasar Undang-Undang No. 40 Tahun 2007 tentang Perseroan Terbatas dan kerangka Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik (GCG). Secara umum, governansi ABM mencakup berbagai kebijakan dan implementasi untuk memastikan tata kelola organisasi yang berintegritas dalam mendukung pencapaian keberlanjutan, yaitu:

## A. Untuk Tingkat Manajemen Senior

- Pencegahan Benturan Kepentingan

ABM mengelola konflik kepentingan melalui penerapan pedoman etika dan tata kelola, pengungkapan rutin, pengawasan oleh komite tata kelola, serta transparansi atas transaksi dengan pihak terkait.

# Management Approach to Governance

ABM develops a governance approach oriented towards sustainability by balancing economic, environmental, and social performance. The ABM governance approach is established based on Law No. 40 of 2007 concerning Limited Liability Companies and the framework of Good Corporate Governance (GCG). Generally, ABM's governance encompasses a variety of policies and implementations at ensuring organizational integrity and supporting the attainment of sustainability, which are:

## A. For Senior Management Level

- Prevention of Conflicts of Interest

ABM manages conflicts of interest by implementing ethical guidelines and governance practices, conducting routine disclosures, overseeing activities through the governance committee, and ensuring transparency in transactions with related parties.

Pengawasan atas penerapan governansi ABM dilakukan oleh Komite Tata Kelola Perusahaan dan diperkuat melalui audit rutin untuk memastikan seluruh kebijakan governansi dijalankan secara konsisten dan efektif.

- Independence of the Board of Directors and Commissioners

# Pencegahan Benturan Kepentingan [GRI 2-9]

ABM memastikan pencegahan benturan kepentingan melalui penerapan pedoman etika dan tata kelola, pengungkapan rutin melalui pernyataan tertulis, pengawasan oleh Komite Tata Kelola Perusahaan, serta pengaturan transaksi afiliasi yang wajib memenuhi ketentuan regulasi, diaudit, dan diungkapkan secara transparan, termasuk pengungkapan keanggotaan lintas dewan, kepemilikan saham lintas organisasi, serta pemegang saham pengendali. Transparansi atas seluruh transaksi pihak berelasi diungkapkan dan dipublikasikan dalam laporan keuangan konsolidasi sesuai dengan standar akuntansi yang berlaku. Melalui mekanisme pencegahan ini, ABM menjaga integritas, keterbukaan, dan kepercayaan dalam penerapan governansi Perusahaan.

# Independensi Dewan Direksi dan Komisaris

[GRI 2-9][GRI 2-11][GRI 2-15] [NDAQ G.2]

ABM menuangkan kebijakan independensi Dewan Direksi dan Komisaris dalam Board Manual yang bersifat mengikat bagi seluruh anggota perusahaan. Dokumen ini menjadi pedoman hubungan internal Perusahaan dan mencakup tugas, wewenang, mekanisme rapat, pengambilan keputusan, serta pengendalian dan pengawasan.

Board Manual menegaskan bahwa Dewan Komisaris harus bersikap independen dalam melakukan pengawasan, serta melarang Direktur Utama (Chief Executive Officer) merangkap sebagai Komisaris guna menjaga efektivitas fungsi kontrol. Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi tidak diperbolehkan memiliki hubungan keluarga satu sama lain, serta tidak ada lintas kepemilikan saham dengan pemasok dan para pemangku kepentingan lain di luar Grup TMT.

Dalam menjalankan fungsi pengawasan, ABM menunjukkan menempatkan Komisaris Independen untuk mengawasi kinerja Direksi, memberikan masukan secara objektif, dan memastikan penerapan GCG berjalan dengan semestinya.

Pada tahun 2025, ABM memiliki dua Komisaris Independen yang mewakili 50% dari total anggota Dewan Komisaris. Komposisi ini mencerminkan komitmen Perseroan terhadap pengawasan yang independen dan tata kelola yang seimbang.

# Conflict of Interest Prevention [GRI 2-9]

ABM ensures the prevention of conflicts of interest through the implementation of ethical guidelines and governance principles, routine disclosures via written statements, oversight by the Corporate Governance Committee, and regulation of affiliate transactions that must adhere to regulatory standards, be audited, and transparently disclosed, including disclosures of cross-board memberships, cross-organization shareholdings, and controlling shareholders. Transparency regarding all related-party transactions is disclosed and published in consolidated financial reports in accordance with applicable accounting standards. Through this preventive mechanism, ABM upholds integrity, transparency, and trust in the company's governance practices.

# Independence of the Board of Directors and Commissioners

[GRI 2-9][GRI 2-11][GRI 2-15] [NDAQ G.2]

ABM articulates the independence policy of the Board of Directors and Commissioners within the Board Manual, a document that is binding for all company members. This document serves as a guideline for the company's internal relations, encompassing responsibilities, authorities, meeting protocols, decision-making processes, as well as control and supervision.

The Board Manual emphasizes that the Board of Commissioners to operate independently in their supervisory role and explicitly prohibits the President Director (Chief Executive Officer) from concurrently serving as a Commissioner to maintain the effectiveness of the control function. The Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors are barred from possessing familial relationships with one another, and cross-shareholdings with suppliers and other external stakeholders outside the TMT Group are not permitted.

In the conduct of its supervisory responsibilities, ABM appoints and positions Independent Commissioners to oversee the Board of Directors' performance, provide objective input, and ensure the proper implementation of GCG.

By 2025, ABM aims to have two Independent Commissioners, comprising 50% of the total members of the Board of Commissioners. This composition reflects the company's commitment to independent oversight and balanced governance.

Governance and Economy

ABM menerapkan prinsip Tata Kelola Perusahaan yang Baik (GCG) untuk mencegah dan mengelola potensi konflik kepentingan melalui penerapan pedoman etika, kewajiban pengungkapan konflik kepentingan secara berkala, serta pengawasan oleh Komite Tata Kelola Perusahaan. Transaksi afiliasi dilaksanakan sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku melalui proses penelaahan, audit, dan pengungkapan secara transparan kepada pemangku kepentingan, termasuk pengungkapan keanggotaan lintas dewan, kepemilikan saham lintas entitas, serta transaksi dengan pihak berelasi dalam laporan keuangan konsolidasian.

Dalam struktur tata kelola, ABM mematuhi ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan di Indonesia yang menganut sistem dua tingkat dengan pemisahan peran antara Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris. Direktur Utama tidak merangkap jabatan sebagai Komisaris Utama di Perseroan, namun dapat menjabat sebagai Komisaris Utama pada entitas anak sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku.

Informasi lebih rinci mengenai struktur komite di bawah Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi, termasuk tugas dan tanggung jawab masing-masing komite, disajikan dalam Laporan Tahunan dan dapat merujuk pada bagian Tata Kelola Perusahaan.

ABM implements the principles of GCG to prevent and manage potential conflicts of interest through the implementation of ethical guidelines, periodic disclosure obligations concerning conflicts of interest, and oversight by the Corporate Governance Committee. Transactions with related parties are executed in compliance with applicable regulations through review processes, audits, and transparent disclosures to stakeholders, including disclosures of cross-board memberships, cross-entity shareholdings, and transactions with related parties in the consolidated financial statements.

In its governance structure, ABM complies with Indonesian laws that adopt a two-tier system with a separation of roles between the Board of Directors and the Board of Commissioners. The President Director does not concurrently serve as the President Commissioner but may serve as the President Commissioner of subsidiaries in accordance with applicable regulations.

More detailed information regarding the committee structures under the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors, including their duties and responsibilities, is provided in the Annual Report and can be referenced in the Corporate Governance section.

# Nominasi Badan Tata Kelola Tertinggi

[GRI 2-10]

ABM menerapkan proses nominasi yang terstruktur dan mengacu pada ketentuan yang berlaku bagi perusahaan terbuka. Proses ini bertujuan memastikan anggota Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi memiliki kompetensi, integritas, serta kemandirian yang memadai untuk menjalankan fungsi pengawasan dan pengelolaan Perusahaan.

# Proses Nominasi Dewan Komisaris

Sebagai perusahaan publik, ABM wajib memiliki Komisaris Independen dengan jumlah minimal 30% dari total anggota Dewan Komisaris. Komisaris Independen berasal dari pihak eksternal yang bebas dari pengaruh Dewan Komisaris, Direksi, maupun Pemegang Saham Pengendali. Selain itu, sekurangkurangnya satu anggota Dewan Komisaris wajib memiliki latar belakang akuntansi dan/atau keuangan.

Proses nominasi dilakukan oleh Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi (KNR) yang menilai kualifikasi, pengalaman, serta kepatuhan terhadap persyaratan regulator. Rekomendasi KNR selanjutnya disampaikan kepada Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham (RUPS) untuk memperoleh persetujuan pengangkatan.

# Proses Nominasi Direksi

Direksi berjumlah minimal dua orang, termasuk satu Direktur Utama. KNR melakukan penilaian awal terhadap calon Direksi dan mengajukan rekomendasi kepada RUPS. Calon Direksi dievaluasi berdasarkan pengalaman kepemimpinan, pemahaman terhadap risiko, serta kesesuaian dengan kebutuhan bisnis Perusahaan.

# Sumber Calon dan Prioritas Seleksi

ABM memprioritaskan calon yang berasal dari internal Grup, seperti Direktur Entitas Anak atau karyawan yang telah mengikuti pengembangan kepemimpinan. # Nomination of the Highest Governance Body [GRI 2-10]

ABM implements a structured nomination process based on applicable regulations for publicly listed companies. This process aims to ensure that members of the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors possess adequate competence, integrity, and independence to carry out the supervisory and management functions of the Company.

# Nomination Process for the Board of Commissioners

As a publicly listed company, ABM is required to appoint an Independent Commissioner constituting at least 30% of the total Board of Commissioners members. The Independent Commissioner must come from an external party who is free from influence by the Board of Commissioners, the Board of Directors, or the Controlling Shareholders. Furthermore, at least one member of the Board of Commissioners must have a background in accounting and/or finance.

The nomination process is conducted by the Nomination and Remuneration Committee (NRC), which assesses the qualifications, experience, and compliance with regulatory requirements. The NRC's recommendations are subsequently submitted to the General Meeting of Shareholders (GMS) for the approval of the appointment.

# Board of Directors Nomination Process

The board of directors is composed of a minimum of two individuals, including one President Director. KNR conducts an initial assessment of the prospective directors and submits its recommendations to the GMS. The candidates are assessed based on their leadership experience, risk comprehension, and their suitability to the company's business needs.

# Candidate Sources and Selection Priorities

ABM prioritizes candidates from within the Group, such as subsidiary directors or employees who have participated in leadership development. However, the Company remains open to external candidates if there are no suitable internal candidates, certain legal provisions apply, or regional representation is needed.
