Penentuan kebijakan Compensation & Benefit (C&B) dan Talent Management bagi eksekutif dilakukan berdasarkan filosofi ABM, yaitu meningkatkan motivasi, mendukung sinergi antar entitas, mengembangkan talenta, mendorong pertumbuhan profesional, dan mengoptimalkan biaya. Struktur C&B dirancang untuk:

- Menyelaraskan total penghasilan dengan kinerja bisnis dan pasar;
- Meningkatkan proporsi remunerasi variabel;
- Mendorong budaya kinerja dan sinergi;
- Menstandarkan kebijakan remunerasi;
- Menjaga daya saing pasar; serta
- Memberikan manfaat kesejahteraan yang mendukung pencapaian peran eksekutif.

## Pengawasan dan Persetujuan Remunerasi

Proses penentuan remunerasi diawasi oleh Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi (KNR) sebagai komite independen di bawah Dewan Komisaris. KNR bertanggung jawab memastikan proses penilaian remunerasi dilakukan secara objektif, transparan, dan akuntabel. Penetapan remunerasi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi kemudian dimintakan persetujuan melalui Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham (RUPS) sebagai bentuk keterlibatan pemangku kepentingan utama.

Pada tahun 2025, ABM belum melibatkan pemangku kepentingan lain di luar RUPS dalam proses pengambilan keputusan remunerasi.

With this approach, ESG is not positioned as a separate initiative; rather, it integrates it into the Company operational conduct and manages its business. Each ESG target is designed to align with sustainable operations, business resilience, compliance with regulations, and the strengthening of the Company's reputation among stakeholders. Through the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework, ESG aspects are also mapped as part of strategic and operational risk that are monitored periodically. Consequently, all decisions are made with consideration of not only short-term performance but also their implications for sustainability and long-term value creation.

## Remuneration Policy Design Process

The determination of Compensation & Benefits (C&B) and Talent Management policies for executives is founded upon the ABM philosophy, which seeks to enhance motivation, foster synergy among entities, develop talent, encourage professional growth, and optimize costs. The C&B structure is designed to:

- Align total compensation with business performance and market standards;
- Increase the proportion of variable remuneration;
- Promote a culture of performance and synergy;
- Standardize remuneration policies;
- Maintain market competitiveness; and
- Provide welfare benefits that support the achievement of executive roles.

## Supervision and Approval of Remuneration

The process of determining remuneration is overseen by the Nomination and Remuneration Committee (NRC), functioning as an independent committee under the Board of Commissioners. The NRC bears the responsibility of ensuring that the remuneration assessment process is conducted with objectivity, transparency, and accountability. The determination of remuneration for the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors is subsequently submitted for approval through the General Meeting of Shareholders (GMS), serving as a form of engagement with key stakeholders.

By 2025, ABM has not involved other stakeholders beyond the GMS into the remuneration decision-making process.

# Whistleblowing System (Sistem Pengaduan Pelanggaran)

ABM memiliki mekanisme Whistleblowing System (WBS) yang memungkinkan karyawan dan pemangku kepentingan melaporkan dugaan pelanggaran etika atau korupsi secara aman tanpa risiko pembalasan. Grup ABM menyediakan berbagai kanal pelaporan, termasuk email khusus dan PO Box yang dioperasikan secara independen oleh Komite Audit selama 24/7, serta jalur alternatif melalui atasan, HR, Legal, Compliance, atau Internal Audit.

Sepanjang 2025, ABM menerima sejumlah 33 laporan dugaan pelanggaran etika melalui mekanisme pengaduan yang tersedia. Seluruh laporan ditindaklanjuti melalui proses investigasi rahasia oleh Tim Internal Audit sebagai bentuk respon, serta didukung penetapan tindakan korektif dan langkah remediasi untuk mencegah terulangnya kejadian serupa. Untuk kasus yang kompleks, Perusahaan dapat melibatkan ahli forensik eksternal, dan selama proses investigasi karyawan yang terlibat dapat dikenakan penonaktifan sementara guna menjaga integritas proses.

Apabila dugaan terbukti, ABM menjatuhkan sanksi sesuai Peraturan Perusahaan dan tingkat pelanggaran, mulai dari teguran tertulis hingga pemutusan hubungan kerja. Dalam hal terdapat pelanggaran terhadap peraturan perundang-undangan, Perusahaan menyampaikan laporan kepada otoritas yang berwenang, termasuk OJK dan Bursa Efek Indonesia, sebagai bagian dari komitmen kepatuhan. Hasil penanganan kasus, dengan tetap menjaga kerahasiaan, dapat dikomunikasikan sebagai pembelajaran untuk memperkuat budaya tanpa toleransi terhadap korupsi.

ABM menerapkan kebijakan non-retaliasi dan memastikan setiap pelapor yang menyampaikan laporan dengan itikad baik memperoleh perlindungan. Informasi mengenai mekanisme Whistleblowing System (WBS) dikomunikasikan secara berkelanjutan melalui pelatihan, orientasi karyawan baru, dan berbagai media internal.

# Whistleblowing System (Violation Reporting System)

ABM has implemented a Whistleblowing System (WBS) mechanism that allows employees and stakeholders to report suspected ethical violations or corruption securely, without fear of retaliation. The ABM Group offers multiple reporting channels, including a dedicated email and a PO Box operated independently by the Audit Committee 24/7, as well as alternative channels through supervisors, Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, or Internal Audit.

Throughout 2025, ABM received a total of 33 reports of suspected ethical violations through the available grievance mechanism. All reports are followed up with confidential investigation processes conducted by the Internal Audit Team as a form of response, supported by the implementation of corrective actions and remediation steps to prevent similar incidents from recurring. For complex cases, the Company may involve external forensic experts, and during the investigation, involved employees may be placed on temporary administrative leave to maintain the integrity of the process.

If the suspicion is proven, ABM imposes sanctions in accordance with the Company Regulations and the severity of the violation, which may vary from written warnings to termination of employment. In cases of violations of laws and regulations, the Company reports these to the relevant authorities, including OJK and the Indonesia Stock Exchange, as part of our compliance. The outcomes of case handling, while maintaining confidentiality, may be shared as lessons learned to reinforce a culture of zero tolerance for corruption.

ABM implements a non-retaliation policy and guarantees protection for any whistleblower acting in good faith. Information regarding the Whistleblowing System (WBS) mechanism is continuously communicated through training, new employee orientations, and various internal media.

# Komitmen dan Pendekatan ABM dalam Remediasi Dampak Negatif [GRI 2-25]

ABM berkomitmen untuk mengelola dan meremediasi setiap dampak negatif yang mungkin ditimbulkan oleh kegiatan operasional Perusahaan. Komitmen ini mencerminkan prinsip tata kelola yang bertanggung jawab, perlindungan terhadap pemangku kepentingan, serta integrasi nilai-nilai keberlanjutan dalam seluruh proses bisnis.

Dengan demikian, ABM secara efektif mengelola risiko dan memastikan bahwa praktik bisnisnya berjalan selaras dengan nilai keberlanjutan serta kepentingan semua pihak terkait. Berikut adalah pendekatan-pendekatan ABM dan langkah-langkah remediasi untuk mengurangi dampak negatif tersebut.

# Identifikasi Dampak Negatif dan Langkah Remediasi

ABM mengidentifikasi tingkat dan sifat dampak negatif, mengembangkan langkah-langkah remediasi, dan mengimplementasikannya. Proses identifikasi dilakukan melalui risk assessment berkala, audit internal, serta pelaporan insiden dari unit operasional. Apabila Perusahaan diidentifikasi sebagai penyebab atau kontributor dampak negatif, ABM wajib melakukan tindakan pemulihan yang proporsional, termasuk pemulihan lingkungan, koreksi operasional, atau kompensasi sesuai kebutuhan. Analisis akar penyebab dilakukan untuk memastikan penguatan pengendalian, pembaruan kebijakan, serta pelaksanaan pelatihan tambahan guna mencegah terulangnya dampak serupa.

# Mekanisme Pengaduan

ABM telah menetapkan mekanisme pengaduan untuk mengidentifikasi dan menangani setiap keluhan yang disampaikan oleh para pemangku kepentingan, termasuk karyawan, pemasok, pelanggan, dan masyarakat. Dalam penerapannya, ABM juga memberikan perhatian khusus kepada pemangku kepentingan rentan, yaitu kelompok masyarakat yang berisiko mengalami diskriminasi atau kekerasan seperti penyandang disabilitas, perempuan, dan kelompok etnis minoritas, serta masyarakat yang hidup di bawah garis kemiskinan di wilayah operasional ABM.

Sebagai bagian dari mekanisme tersebut, ABM menyediakan saluran Whistleblowing yang dapat diakses oleh masyarakat luas. Pendekatan Perusahaan dalam mengelola pengaduan dilakukan melalui pelibatan pemangku kepentingan secara berkala, penyediaan berbagai kanal penyampaian keluhan, serta proses penelaahan, investigasi, dan tindak lanjut yang dilaksanakan secara tepat waktu dan efektif.

# Commitment and ABM Approach in Remediating Negative Impacts [GRI 2-25]

ABM is committed to managing and remediating any potential negative impacts caused by the Company's operational activities. This commitment reflects responsible governance, emphasizes stakeholder protection, and the integration of sustainability values into all business processes.

Therefore, ABM effectively manages risks and ensures that its business practices align with sustainability values and the interests of all stakeholders. Presented below are ABM's approaches and remediation steps to reduce these negative impacts.

# Identify Negative Impacts and Remediation Steps

ABM identifies the extent and characteristics of negative impacts, develops remedial measures, and implements them. The identification process is conducted through routine risk assessments, internal audits, and incident reports from operational units. Should the Company be identified as the source or contributor to negative impacts, ABM is required to take appropriate recovery actions, including environmental restoration, operational corrections, or compensation as needed. Root cause analysis is conducted to ensure strengthened controls, updated policies, and provide additional training to prevent the recurrence of similar impacts.

# Complaint Mechanism

ABM has established a complaints mechanism to identify and resolve grievances submitted by stakeholders, including employees, suppliers, customers, and the community. In its implementation, ABM also allocates particular attention to vulnerable stakeholders, such as groups at risk of discrimination or violence, including persons with disabilities, women, and minority ethnic groups, as well as communities living below the poverty line in ABM's operational areas.

As part of this mechanism, ABM provides a Whistleblowing channel accessible to the general public. The Company's approach to managing complaints involves regular stakeholder engagement, providing multiple channels for submitting grievances, and conducting review, investigation, and follow-up processes that are conducted promptly and efficiently.

# Management Approach For Economic Performance

In addition to focusing on sustainability issues, profitability is an important element for ABM in distributing economic value to all stakeholders. By 2025, ABM achieved positive operational and financial performance despite the increasingly complex dynamics in the mining and energy industries. ## Comparison of Economic Performance

Pada tahun 2025, ABM memandang pencapaian kinerja ekonomi sebagai bagian yang tidak terpisahkan dari strategi keberlanjutan jangka panjang. Pertumbuhan usaha dilakukan dengan mengacu pada pencapaian target produksi, kinerja pendapatan, serta laba Perseroan yang selaras dengan prinsip tata kelola perusahaan yang baik dan komitmen terhadap aspek sosial dan lingkungan. Setiap peningkatan kinerja operasional diimbangi dengan upaya pengelolaan dampak lingkungan dan sosial di wilayah operasional untuk memastikan keberlanjutan nilai ekonomi yang dihasilkan.

Sejalan dengan praktik pengelolaan kinerja perusahaan, ABM melakukan evaluasi kinerja ekonomi melalui perbandingan antara target yang telah ditetapkan dengan realisasi produksi, pendapatan, dan laba. Hasil evaluasi tersebut menjadi dasar bagi manajemen dalam menilai efektivitas strategi bisnis, mengidentifikasi peluang perbaikan, serta memastikan bahwa kinerja ekonomi yang dicapai tetap berkelanjutan. Rincian kinerja keuangan dan analisis lebih lanjut disajikan dalam Laporan Tahunan ABM pada bagian Management Discussion and Analysis.

In 2025, ABM views economic performance as integral to its long-term sustainability strategy. Business growth is pursued by focusing on achieving production targets, improving revenue performance, and boosting profits, all aligned with principles of sound corporate governance and commitments to social and environmental responsibilities. Each increase in operational performance is prudently balanced with efforts to manage environmental and social impacts within operational areas to ensure the sustainability of the economic value generated.

In line with corporate performance management practices, ABM evaluates its economic performance by comparing predetermined targets with actual production, revenue, and profit realizations. The results of this evaluation serve as a basis for management to assess the effectiveness of business strategies, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure the sustainability of the achieved economic performance. Details regarding financial performance and additional analyses are provided in ABM's Annual Report within the Management Discussion and Analysis section.

## Pengelolaan Dampak Iklim

Dampak iklim turut membuat ABM bersiaga untuk menangani risiko lingkungan hidup yang dapat berpengaruh pada bisnis. Curah hujan tinggi di CK menghambat kegiatan tambang. Pada 2025, lokasi TIA dan BMB terdampak banjir, sehingga memicu proses klaim asuransi. Kombinasi faktor-faktor tersebut berdampak pada penurunan produksi dan penjualan selama periode pelaporan.

Climate impacts further necessitate that ABM remain vigilant in managing environmental risks that could potentially influence the business. Heavy rainfall in CK disrupts mining activities. # Transparansi Perpajakan
## Tax Transparency

Komitmen ABM terhadap transparansi perpajakan tidak hanya diwujudkan melalui pemenuhan kewajiban pajak, tetapi juga melalui kontribusi kepada negara dalam bentuk Penerimaan Negara Bukan Pajak (PNBP), pelaksanaan Domestic Market Obligation (DMO), serta pembayaran royalti. Seluruh kewajiban tersebut dipantau dan dievaluasi setiap bulan untuk memastikan pelaporan dan pembayaran telah sesuai dengan regulasi perpajakan dan ketentuan yang berlaku.

# Tata Kelola Transparansi dan Risiko terkait Pajak [GRI 207-1 & 207-2]

Pengelolaan perpajakan ABM berada di bawah tanggung jawab Direktur Keuangan dengan dukungan pejabat senior yang menangani fungsi perpajakan di seluruh Grup ABM. Pendekatan ini memastikan kepatuhan terhadap peraturan perpajakan yang berlaku serta memperkuat integritas tata kelola pajak. Untuk menjaga kredibilitas dan transparansi, ABM melibatkan auditor independen dalam audit eksternal, dengan hasil pengujian dan opini yang diungkapkan secara terbuka melalui laporan tahunan.

ABM menerapkan pendekatan yang terstruktur dalam mengelola risiko perpajakan, mencakup proses identifikasi, pengelolaan, dan pemantauan risiko secara berkelanjutan. Strategi perpajakan ditinjau dan disetujui secara berkala oleh Direktur Keuangan, serta diintegrasikan ke dalam proses bisnis dan kebijakan internal agar selaras dengan strategi Perusahaan dan komitmen terhadap pembangunan berkelanjutan. Isu perpajakan yang bersifat signifikan, termasuk risiko kepatuhan dan potensi sengketa pajak, dipantau dan dievaluasi melalui mekanisme pengawasan internal, antara lain melalui Komite Audit. Isu-isu tersebut selanjutnya dieselaksikan kepada Direksi sesuai dengan ketentuan tata kelola Perusahaan yang berlaku.

Sebagai bagian dari penguatan tata kelola, ABM menyediakan mekanisme pelaporan pelanggaran terkait perpajakan yang dikelola secara independen untuk menjamin kerahasiaan dan penanganan laporan secara transparan. Evaluasi kepatuhan perpajakan dilakukan melalui audit eksternal, sementara proses penjaminan atas pengungkapan pajak dijelaskan dalam laporan tahunan melalui rujukan terhadap laporan audit dan opini penjaminan, sebagai bentuk akuntabilitas kepada para pemangku kepentingan.

ABM's dedication to tax transparency is demonstrated not only by fulfilling tax obligations but also through contributions to the state in the form of Non-Tax State Revenue (PNBP), the implementation of Domestic Market Obligation (DMO), and royalty payments. All these obligations are subject to monthly to ensure that reporting and payments comply with tax regulations and applicable provisions.

# Tax Governance, Transparency, and Risk Management [GRI 207-1 & 207-2]

Tax management at ABM is under the responsibility of the Finance Director, supported by senior officials responsible for tax functions across the ABM Group. This approach ensures compliance with relevant tax regulations and strengthens tax governance. To maintain credibility and transparency, ABM engages independent auditors for external audits, with testing results and opinions openly disclosed in the annual report.

ABM implements a structured approach to managing tax risks, including the processes of identifying, managing, and continuously monitoring of such risks. The tax strategy undergoes periodic review and approval by the Chief Financial Officer and is integrated into business processes and internal policies to ensure alignment with the Company's strategy and commitment to sustainable development. Notable tax issues, including compliance risks and potential disputes, are vigilantly monitored and evaluated through internal oversight mechanisms, such as the Audit Committee. These issues are subsequently escalated to the Board of Directors in accordance with the Company's governance policies.

As part of strengthening governance, ABM provides an independent whistleblowing mechanism for reporting tax-related violations, ensuring confidentiality and transparent handling of reports. Tax compliance is evaluated through external audits, while the process of assurance over tax disclosures is detailed in the annual report through references to audit reports and assurance opinions, as a form of accountability to stakeholders.

# Bantuan Finansial yang Diterima dari Pemerintah [GRI 201-4]

Financial Assistance Received from the Government

Sepanjang tahun 2025, ABM tidak menerima bantuan atau insentif finansial dari pemerintah dalam bentuk apa pun. Perusahaan tidak memperoleh keringanan pajak, kredit pajak, subsidi, hibah investasi, maupun hibah untuk penelitian dan pengembangan. Selain itu, ABM tidak menerima fasilitas pembebasan royalti, bantuan dari lembaga kredit ekspor, maupun bentuk manfaat finansial lainnya dari pemerintah untuk mendukung kegiatan operasional Perusahaan.

Selama periode pelaporan, ABM juga tidak menerima bentuk dukungan tidak langsung dari pemerintah, seperti jaminan pemerintah, penyediaan infrastruktur yang dibiayai pemerintah, atau akses eksklusif terhadap sumber daya publik. Perusahaan menjalankan aktivitas bisnis secara independen tanpa ketergantungan pada dukungan finansial negara.

Selain itu, pada tahun yang sama, tidak terdapat partisipasi pemerintah dalam struktur kepemilikan saham ABM. Perusahaan sepenuhnya dimiliki oleh pihak swasta dan tidak memiliki pemegang saham yang merupakan badan pemerintah atau entitas yang dikendalikan pemerintah.

Oleh karena itu, ABM dapat memastikan bahwa seluruh operasional dan kinerja finansial Perusahaan tidak bergantung pada bantuan pemerintah dan mencerminkan keberlanjutan bisnis yang mandiri dan berintegritas.

Throughout the year 2025, ABM did not receive any form of financial assistance or incentives from the government. The Company did not obtain tax relief, tax credits, subsidies, investment grants, or research and development grants. Additionally, ABM did not receive royalty exemption facilities, support from export credit agencies, or other financial benefits from the government to support the Company's operational activities.

During the reporting period, ABM did not receive any form of indirect support from the government, such as guarantees, government-funded infrastructure, or exclusive access to public resources. The Company conducts our business activities independently, without reliance on government financial support.

Furthermore, in the same year, there was no government participation in ABM's share ownership structure. The Company is fully owned by private parties and has no shareholders that are government agencies or entities controlled by the government.

Therefore, ABM affirms that all of the Company's operations and financial performance are not depend on government assistance and reflect a sustainable, independent, and integrity-driven business.

Untuk itu, ABM menjaga komunikasi dan kolaborasi yang erat dengan seluruh penyedia barang dan jasa, sekaligus memprioritaskan keterlibatan pemasok lokal guna menciptakan multiplier effect bagi kesejahteraan masyarakat di sekitar wilayah operasi.

## Komponen Utama Sistem Pengadaan ABM [NDAQ GS]

Untuk memastikan proses pengadaan berlangsung transparan dan akuntabel, ABM menerapkan serangkaian kriteria dan mekanisme utama yang menjadi dasar pengelolaan rantai pasok Perusahaan. Pendekatan ini dirancang untuk mendukung tata kelola perusahaan yang bertanggung jawab serta memastikan integrasi aspek lingkungan, sosial, dan etika bisnis dalam seluruh proses pengadaan.

## Seleksi dan Evaluasi Pemasok [GRI 308-1] [GRI 308-2][GRI 414-1][GRI 414-2]

ABM menerapkan proses seleksi dan evaluasi pemasok yang terstruktur dan konsisten di seluruh unit bisnis. Tahapan awal dimulai dengan registrasi calon pemasok yang mengacu pada ketentuan pemerintah sesuai klasifikasi usaha berdasarkan KBLI, dilanjutkan dengan evaluasi teknis dan komersial yang dilakukan secara sistematis.

Kriteria penilaian pemasok mencakup aspek non-komersial dan komersial. Aspek non-komersial meliputi kualitas, ketepatan waktu pengiriman, keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja, serta kepatuhan terhadap ketentuan lingkungan dan sosial. ABM recognizes that effective supply chain governance is a crucial foundation for the seamless operation of the Company. Consequently, ABM maintains close communication and collaboration with all suppliers of goods and services, with an emphasis on engaging local suppliers to generate a multiplier effect for the welfare of the communities around the operational areas.

To ensure consistency, transparency, and efficiency, ABM has instituted policies and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) applicable across all group entities. These policies oversee the entire procurement process, including supplier registration, selection, evaluation, and contract management, ensuring strict adherence to the Company's regulations and standards.

## Main Components of the ABM Procurement System [NDAQ GS]

# Manajemen Risiko

Sistem Manajemen Risiko Grup ABM telah diformalkan melalui Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Policy No. ABM-PLC-ERM-001 tanggal 21 Agustus 2021 dan SOP No. ABM-SOP-ERM-001 tanggal 25 September 2021, guna memastikan penerapan strategi mitigasi risiko yang konsisten serta dukungan sumber daya yang memadai.

Penerapan manajemen risiko di ABM mengacu pada model tiga lini. Departemen ERM berperan sebagai lini kedua yang mengawasi dan mendukung pelaksanaan manajemen risiko melalui pengembangan kerangka kerja, pendampingan, serta pemantauan implementasi mitigasi risiko. # Risk Management

In managing risks, including those related to climate change, ABM applies ISO 31000 as the risk management framework, which is centrally implemented at the company and subsidiary levels. The ABM Group Risk Management System has been formalized through the Corporate Risk Management Policy (ERM) No. ABM-PLC-ERM-001 dated August 21, 2021, and SOP No. ABM-SOP-ERM-001 dated September 25, 2021, to ensure consistent application of risk mitigation strategies and adequate resource allocation.

The implementation of risk management at ABM refers to the three lines model. The first line includes Risk Owners and Risk Champions, who have direct responsibility for risk management within their respective functions and entities. The ERM Department serves as the second line, overseeing and supporting risk management activities through the development of frameworks, guidance, and the monitoring of risk mitigation efforts. Structurally, the ERM function reports to the Director and is led by the Head of the Risk Management Division.

Melalui penerapan skenario RCP, ABM akan menilai risiko fisik dan risiko transisi di bawah berbagai tingkat pemanasan global, serta mengidentifikasi implikasinya terhadap operasi pertambangan, logistik, investasi, dan strategi diversifikasi bisnis. Hasil analisis ini akan menjadi dasar dalam pengambilan keputusan strategis, perencanaan mitigasi dan adaptasi iklim, serta peningkatan ketahanan bisnis ABM dalam menghadapi ketidakpastian iklim di masa depan.

ABM is committed to conducting climate scenario analysis as part of strengthening risk management and long-term strategic planning. This analysis will utilize the Representative Concentration Pathways (RCP) approach to evaluate the potential impacts of climate change on operational performance, asset resilience, and the company's risk profile across various operational areas.

Through the implementation of RCP scenarios, ABM will assess physical and transition risks associated with different global warming levels, as well as identify their implications for mining operations, logistics, investments, and business diversification strategies. The results of this analysis will serve as a basis for strategic decision-making, climate mitigation and adaptation planning, and enhancing ABM's business resilience in facing future climate-related uncertainties.

## Strategi

Perubahan iklim mendorong ABM untuk menyesuaikan strategi bisnis guna menjaga ketahanan operasional dan mendukung transisi energi nasional. Risiko iklim yang paling material bagi ABM mencakup risiko fisik, seperti banjir ekstrem, longsor, suhu tinggi, dan kekeringan yang berdampak pada operasi pertambangan, logistik, dan distribusi bahan bakar, serta risiko transisi yang berasal dari perubahan regulasi emisi, perkembangan teknologi rendah karbon, dinamika pasar energi bersih, dan ekspektasi investor.

Sebagai respons, ABM telah menetapkan Kebijakan Perubahan Iklim yang menjadi dasar pengelolaan risiko dan peluang iklim. Kebijakan ini menegaskan pengawasan oleh Dewan Komisaris melalui Komite ESG bersama Direksi, komitmen terhadap kepatuhan regulasi, pelaksanaan aksi nyata pengurangan dampak iklim di seluruh entitas anak, integrasi aksi iklim ke dalam praktik bisnis berkelanjutan, serta pengungkapan yang transparan. Seluruh inisiatif iklim tersebut diarahkan untuk memberikan kontribusi positif terhadap aspek Lingkungan, Sosial, dan Tata Kelola (ESG) serta meningkatkan nilai jangka panjang Perusahaan. ## Strategy

Climate change is compelling ABM to adapt its business strategies to maintain operational resilience and support the national energy transition. The most significant climate risks for ABM include physical hazards such as severe flooding, landslides, high temperatures, and droughts, which affect mining activities, logistics, and fuel distribution. Additionally, transition risks stem from evolving emission regulations, advancements in low-carbon technologies, dynamics in the clean energy market, and changing investor expectations.

In response, ABM has established a Climate Change Policy that forms the foundation for managing climate-related risks and opportunities. This policy emphasizes oversight by the Board of Commissioners through the ESG Committee alongside the Board of Directors, demonstrates a commitment to regulatory compliance, and includes the implementation of tangible actions to mitigate climate impacts across all subsidiaries, and integrates climate actions into sustainable business practices with transparent disclosure. All these initiatives are aimed at positively contributing to Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) aspects and at increasing the Company's long-term value. [SEOJK F.3]

# Langkah Nyata ABM Memasuki Energi Terbarukan melalui Biogas

AJN merupakan entitas anak ABM yang berfokus pada pengembangan solusi energi terbarukan, khususnya melalui pemanfaatan limbah industri kelapa sawit sebagai sumber energi bersih. Inisiatif ini menjadi langkah nyata pertama ABM dalam sektor energi terbarukan, yang melengkapi rantai nilai bisnis inti Perusahaan di bidang pertambangan. Berlokasi di Kalimantan Selatan, AJN mengoperasikan Pembangkit Listrik Tenaga Biogas (PLTBg) yang mengolah Palm Oil Mill Effluent (POME) dan residu sawit menjadi biogas untuk kemudian dikonversi menjadi energi listrik.

Selama periode 2021-2025, operasional PLTBg AJN berhasil menghindari emisi sebesar 56.486,31 ton CO₂e, menunjukkan kontribusi nyata ABM terhadap upaya mitigasi perubahan iklim. Pendekatan ini mencerminkan penerapan ekonomi sirkular, di mana limbah industri dimanfaatkan kembali menjadi sumber energi terbarukan yang bernilai. Pada tahun 2025, AJN juga telah memperoleh Sertifikat Pengurangan Emisi Gas Rumah Kaca (SPE-GRK) dari SRN-PPI Kementerian Lingkungan Hidup, sekaligus memperkuat peran ABM dalam mendukung Roadmap Net Zero Emission Indonesia 2060 dan transisi energi berkelanjutan.

# ABM's Concrete Step into Renewable Energy through Biogas

AJN is a subsidiary of ABM focused on developing renewable energy solutions, with a particular focus on utilizing palm oil mill waste as a clean energy source. This initiative marks ABM's first significant step into the renewable energy sector, supplementing the Company's core business value chain in mining. Located in South Kalimantan, AJN operates a Biogas Power Plant (PLTBg) that processes Palm Oil Mill Effluent (POME) and palm residues into biogas, which is then converted into electricity.

During the period of 2021 to 2025, AJN's PLTBg operations have avoided the emission of 56,486.31 tons of CO₂e, demonstrating ABM's tangible contribution to climate change mitigation efforts. This approach reflects the implementation of a circular economy, in which industrial waste is repurposed as a valuable renewable energy source. By 2025, AJN has also obtained the Greenhouse Gas Emission Reduction Certificate (SPE-GRK) from SRN-PPI of the Ministry of Environment and Forestry, further strengthening ABM's commitment to supporting Indonesia's Net Zero Emission Roadmap 2060 and the transition towards sustainable energy.

# ADHERENCE TO THE AA1000AS v3

## Inclusivity:

ABM ensures inclusiveness by proactively identifying and engaging with diverse stakeholder groups, whose concerns are systematically addressed throughout the Report. Its approach to stakeholder engagement is supported by formal strategies designed to foster ongoing communication and collaboration. This commitment comes from the highest levels of leadership within the organization. Engagement activities include a variety of formats, including customer and employee surveys, meetings, and group discussions. Each interaction is carefully documented, and dedicated personnel are responsible for managing the feedback received. In addition, ABM is transparent in communicating sustainability goals and commitments to stakeholders. This ensures that stakeholders are well-informed about initiatives and progress toward its sustainability goals.

## Materiality:

ABM has systematically conducted a materiality assessment of sustainability issues, taking into account the industry landscape, due diligence findings, risk assessments and stakeholder engagement. This assessment, which has become an annual practice, is a cornerstone of their commitment to sustainability. The Sustainability Steering Group reflecting the commitment of top management, carefully reviews and approves the list of material issues. The materiality assessment provides a comprehensive understanding of the relevant issues. These material issues are then methodically addressed in specific sections, each outlined by measurable metrics. ABM's senior management and cross-functional teams are well versed in these processes, which are informed by extensive documentation and interviews.

## Responsiveness:

ABM is committed to addressing stakeholder concerns through a multi-faceted approach embedded in the sustainability strategy, policies, procedures, code of conduct and established sustainability goals. ABM actively promotes stakeholder engagement through various channels, including multi-stakeholder platforms and customer interfaces. In particular, the dialog-driven approach is exemplified throughout the Report.

## Impact:

ABM adheres to the GRI 2021, which prioritize the assessment of internal and external impacts. ABM has systematically identified the impacts associated with its operations and products. Their commitment to impact assessment is reflected in careful documentation and tracking of impacts through internal processes and systems. Impact analysis covering environmental, economic, social, people and its human rights. In addition, their commitment to identifying and mitigating negative impacts is evident in their annual risk and materiality assessment.
